mods.title: Garage Progress Bar
mods.descriptionHtml:
A slim progress bar in the Garage for the vehicle you have selected. It shows that vehicle's research and progression at a glance — drawn with the game's own icons, ticks, and tooltips and styled to match the stock progress bars, so it looks like a native part of the client. It updates live as you switch vehicles or earn XP.

WHAT IT SHOWS

The bar automatically picks the right progression for the selected vehicle:

  • Tech-tree research — researched modules and the next vehicle to unlock.
  • Field Modifications — the post-progression upgrade ladder.
  • Elite Levels — the current grade-band progression once a vehicle is elite.
  • Tier XI exclusive rewards — the milestone reward roadmap earned on Tier XI vehicles.
  • Tier XI skill tree — how many skill-tree upgrades you've unlocked out of the total.
  • Potential Tier XI — an opt-in projection on Tier X vehicles that have no Tier XI of their own, measuring your banked XP against the Tier XI unlock cost (off by default).

INTERACTIVE

Click the bar to research modules, unlock the next vehicle, or apply Tier XI upgrades without leaving the Garage. Hover any tick or icon for a full tooltip — costs, requirements, prerequisite names, affordability, XP-to-reach, and a rough battles-remaining estimate.

NATIVE LOOK & LANGUAGES

Everything is built from the game's own art and text. The mod is fully localized to support any client language.

SETTINGS

With ModsSettingsAPI installed, options appear in the Modification list window: hide the bar completely, or hide it only on fully-progressed vehicles.

CREDITS

Inspired by Zanju's Research Progress Bar.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Requirements

- OpenWG GameFace 1.1.6+

- ModsSettingsAPI 1.7.0+
 

Installation
 

For a one-click setup on Windows, download the installer from the GitHub releases page. It finds your game folder, installs the mod, and adds OpenWG GameFace and ModsSettingsAPI if you don't already have them.
 

To install the .wotmod from here by hand:

1. Close World of Tanks and the Game Center launcher.

2. Make sure OpenWG GameFace is installed in mods\2.3.0.1\.

3. Copy com.14th_ua.garageprogressbar_<version>.wotmod into mods\2.3.0.1\.

4. Delete any older copy of the mod from that folder.

5. Start the game.

6. After a game update, move the .wotmod to the new mods\<version>\ folder. A new client version may need a rebuilt mod.

files.changeLog:
Fixed a phantom Potential Tier XI bar. Tier-X vehicles whose Tier XI successor you have already researched no longer show a stray "potential" bar.
Fixed the Tier XI skill-tree "done" marker. Completing the upgrade tree now correctly turns the chip into its green done marker even when there's no remaining frontier.
Fixed the saved bar position drifting between resolutions. The bar's position is no longer stored as raw pixels, so it stays where you put it when your screen resolution or window size changes. (Existing setups: use Reset if the bar lands off-screen.)
Smoother hovering and no more stale tooltips. Reduced per-frame work while hovering the bar, and tooltips no longer linger after the underlying tick changes.

Actionable, self-clearing done ticks — a researched module tick now buys and mounts the module and clears itself; field-mod done ticks clear when you open the screen.
Estimated battles remaining — tooltips now show an ≈ M–N battles estimate beside the XP shortfall, calibrated from your best-game pace and average, with reserve/first-win bonuses factored in.

Shows a hit marker on your crosshair every time you hit an enemy, set up right in the garage (Mod configurator menu).

mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Download the archive.
2. Open it and copy the mods folder into your World of Tanks game folder. The files go into mods\[version]\, where [version] is your current game client version (this build is for 2.3.0.1, and the folder name changes after each game update). The archive already contains the correct version folder, so a normal extract puts everything in place.
3. Confirm overwriting if asked.
4. Start the game.

Open the settings in the garage through the Mod configurator (mod settings menu) and set the lock key there (default Q). The archive already contains the settings library (modsSettingsApi) needed for that menu; without it the mod runs with default settings.

mods.title: Show vehicle body in the sniper view
mods.descriptionHtml:
Displays your own tank's hull in sniper mode, so you can see your vehicle while you aim.

The battle can start directly in the wide hull view, and one scroll down below the normal zoom levels brings it back at any time. The toggle hotkey shows or hides the hull instantly (default F11, rebindable, CTRL/ALT combinations supported). All options are available in the in-game mod settings menu. 

Note: how the hull looks depends on the tank. On some tanks little of it is visible, and on others the hull or turret sticks into the camera and gets in the way. For tanks like that you have two options: add them to the Vehicle blacklist in the mod settings (the tooltip explains step by step how to find the tank ID), or simply hide the hull in battle with the toggle hotkey (default F11).

Credits:  mod originally by Polyacov_Yury, totally reworked by Aslain

mods.title: the Dynamic Playlists Mod
mods.descriptionHtml:
WoT Dynamic Playlists — by mjrd

Automatically maintains up-to-date vehicle lists in your garage filter, refreshed after every battle and on login. No manual editing, ever. Comes as separate .wotmod files — install only the modules you want.


MOD_DYNPL_MARKS

# Mark 1 65% — Vehicles within 10 percentage points of earning their 1st Mark of Excellence
# Mark 2 85% — Vehicles within 10 percentage points of earning their 2nd Mark of Excellence
# Mark 3 95% — Vehicles within 10 percentage points of earning their 3rd Mark of Excellence
# Mark 4 100% — Vehicles with all 3 marks earned, but live damage rating still below 100%. Sorted by closest to perfect first.


MOD_DYNPL_UPGRADES

# Upgrades — Vehicles with Field Modifications or Tier XI Skill Tree available but not yet fully completed. Only shown when upgrades are actually available (Elite status, not rented or locked).


MOD_DYNPL_WEEKLY

# Weekly — Vehicles eligible for the current Weekly Missions, sorted by priority: missing upgrades first, then those close to a Mark of Excellence, then all remaining eligible vehicles by tier. Updates automatically on weekly reset.


MOD_DYNPL_T11GRIND

# XP grind for TXI — Tech tree Tier X vehicles whose Tier XI successor is not yet in your garage and haven't reached the 326,000 XP threshold yet. Sorted by XP already farmed - closest to the goal first. Vehicles without a known T11 line are included too, as WG will eventually add one.  Updates automatically when you purchase a T11.

 


A vehicle drops out of a list the moment you earn that mark, hit 100%, or finish that upgrade. You'll also get a small in-game notification when it happens for a genuine achievement — not just because a rating dipped or you sold the tank.


support/ideas: https://discord.gg/wF9AfhU7NC
mods.installationGuideHtml:
INSTALLATION
------------
1. Find your current WoT client version folder name. It's the
  subfolder name under your WoT install directory's "mods" folder,
  e.g.:
      <WoT install>\mods\2.3.0.1\
  (open version.xml in your WoT root if you're not sure which
  version you're on)

2. Copy the .wotmod file from this archive's "manual-install"
  folder directly into that "mods\<version>\" folder.

3. Restart World of Tanks completely (not just the garage - a full
  client restart is required for the mod to register).

4. Open Garage -> Fahrzeuge -> Fahrzeuglisten (Vehicle Lists). You
  should see "# Mark 1 65%", "# Mark 2 85%", "# Mark 3 95%",
  "# Mark 4 100%" and "# Upgrades" in the dropdown.

mods.title: Current DPM and dispersion HUD
mods.descriptionHtml:
I was interested to see the actual DPM in events and with perks active. Later added dispersion (100m and meters to target) to have a reason to rage on with actual proof :)
Shows your tank's current DPM (damage per minute) in battle, live,
for every gun type - plus gun accuracy (dispersion) at the tank you
are aiming at and at 100 m. The label is draggable.

----------------------------------------------------------------
USING IT
----------------------------------------------------------------
- The DPM appears as on-screen text, e.g.  DPM: 2,480
- Switch shells (1 / 2 / 3) and the DPM updates to that shell.
- Below it: accuracy at 100 m, and - when you aim at a tank - the
 dispersion at that tank's distance.

- MOVE IT: hold CTRL and left-click-drag the label. Release to drop.
 The position is saved and restored for your next battle.

----------------------------------------------------------------
NOTES
----------------------------------------------------------------
- Tested on World of Tanks PC (EU/NA/Asia), client version 2.3.0.1.
 It should keep working on later client versions unless Wargaming
 changes the relevant game code; if a new version breaks it, copy
 the .wotmod into the new version folder and report any issue.

- Settings are stored in  mods\configs\dpm_display.json  (text
 colour and on-screen position). You normally don't need to touch
 this - just drag the label in battle.

- This is an unofficial fan-made mod, not affiliated with Wargaming.

💾 Remembers your Auto Renew preference between game restarts
💥 Helps prevent wasted boost minutes

❌ Cancels scheduled reserves with the notification’s Cancel button or Ctrl + Alt + R
🛑 Stop Renew disables future renewals without cancelling the current schedule

To cancel the next automatic renewal completely, click Cancel.

mods.title: Custix ModPack
mods.descriptionHtml:
A compact pack of player statistics and handy add-ons for the standard game UI. Nothing extra — just useful mods that work right after install.

✍️ Authorship The core mods of the pack — are developed by Custix.

✅ Wargaming rules compliance
All mods in the pack are developed in accordance with Wargaming's rules for modifications (Fair Play Policy) and do not violate them. The pack contains no prohibited functionality!

📊 Player statistics (BattleStats) Shows player stats right in battle. Pick one rating and mode:

  • Rating: WN8 or WNX (formulas from Tomato.gg)
  • Mode:
    • Last 1000 battles (beta) — your approximate recent form
    • Overall — all-time stats
    • Tanks — stats for the current tank only
  • In battle it shows: average tank tier, number of battles, win rate, and rating (WN8/WNX).

✉️ Message Center

  • Separate battle results tab — adds a tab to the standard message center that shows battle results only.
  • Message Center filter — choose which messages to show (configurable in the mod's settings).

🌐 Remember server Remembers the last server you successfully logged in to and selects it automatically next time.

✅ READY button for the platoon commander Adds a compact READY button that lets the platoon commander change their own readiness without starting the battle.

  • Background color = your state: gray for "not ready", green for "ready".
  • A centered LED shows the rest of the platoon: it lights up when all other members are ready. (v2.22+)
  • The Alt+R keyboard shortcut is also available.

🧩 Libraries The pack also bundles these open-source third-party libraries so the mods work:

  • ModsSettingsAPI (izeberg)
  • ModsListAPI (poliroid)
  • OpenWG: common, gameface, fix.battleresultscache, fix.battleresultsreplays
mods.installationGuideHtml:
⚙️ Installer features

  • Auto-detects the game folder and checks the version.
  • Asks you to close the game before installing.
  • Convenient component selection with a description for each.
  • Extra options: clean mods/res_mods, cache and logs; remember selected mods; reset game settings; delete old updates and replays.
  • Installer languages: Ukrainian and English.

💾 Installation

  1. Close World of Tanks.
  2. Run the installer — it will find the game folder automatically (set it manually if needed).
  3. Select components (exactly one statistics option) and click Install.

mods.title: Camo Selector
mods.descriptionHtml:
⚠️The mod doesnt allow you to buy things you normally cant buy ⚠️


🎨 Universal Customization Mod

Customize your vehicles with almost any customization element that exists in the game.

The mod allows you to apply:

  • 2D styles
  • Camouflages
  • Paints
  • Decals
  • 3D styles
  • Progressive 3D styles
  • 3D attachments
  • Inscriptions
  • Emblems
  • Effects

Mix and match different customization elements to create unique vehicle appearances and experiment with combinations that are normally not available together.

🌐 Style Share

Style Share lets other players who also use the mod see your custom battle appearance.

You can enable or disable Style Share from the Exterior menu.
It is enabled by default.

When enabled:

Your selected custom style can be shared in battle.
You can see shared custom styles from other players who also have the mod enabled.
Players without the mod will not see these shared styles.
If you disable Style Share, your style will not be shared and you will not see shared styles from others.

🛠️ How to use

  1. Open the Exterior menu for the vehicle you want to customize.
  2. Apply any camouflage that you own.
  3. Purchase or confirm the camouflage, then leave the Exterior menu.
  4. Open the Exterior menu again.
  5. Apply any 2D style, camouflage, paint, decal, 3D style, 3D attachment, inscription, or emblem you want.
  6. Leave the Exterior menu by pressing Escape.
  7. Your selected customization will now be applied to the vehicle.

✨ Recommended: Clean Camo

For the best visual experience, using Clean Camo alongside this mod is recommended.

Part 1: https://wgmods.net/6997/

Part 2: https://wgmods.net/6996/

Part 3: https://wgmods.net/7687/


✨ Recommended: Extra Style Filters

Since the mod unlocks everything, having the ability to search and favourite styles / paints etc. is very helpful.

Download: https://wgmods.net/7370/

ℹ️ Important

Have fun creating your own unique tank designs! 🎨

For Support / Questions / Suggestions visit: https://discord.gg/DqZ8fuX43C
Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/Gravity_Assist

mods.title: Custom Sixth Sense
mods.descriptionHtml:
Custom Sixth Sense replaces the Sixth Sense indicator with a fully customizable one that you set up in the garage.

Pick a static or animated icon, move it anywhere on the screen, and adjust how it looks. It comes with a large set of ready-made icons, and you can add your own.

Options:
• Choose a static or animated icon, or add your own
• Drag the icon and the optional countdown timer anywhere on screen
• Adjust the display time, icon scale, opacity and an attention pulse
• Optional countdown timer with custom size, color and format

Your own icons: put a SixthSense.png file in a new folder inside mods/configs/Aslain/customsixthsense/static, then restart the game. Animated icons go in mods/configs/Aslain/customsixthsense/animated with their frames and a config.json.

All settings are available in the garage through the in-game Mod configurator (mod settings menu). The configuration is saved to %APPDATA%\Wargaming.net\WorldOfTanks\mods\Aslain\customsixthsense\customsixthsense.json

Fair play: the optional countdown is only a fixed reminder based on known game timings that you set yourself. It does not read or show the real live spotted state, and when it ends it does not mean you are no longer spotted. The mod does not reveal any hidden information.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Download the archive.
2. Open it and copy the mods folder into your World of Tanks game folder. The mod goes into mods\[version]\ (the version folder, i.e. 2.3.0.1, changes after each game update) and the icon set into mods\configs. The archive already has the correct structure, so a normal extract puts everything in place.
3. Confirm overwriting if asked.
4. Start the game.

Open the settings in the garage through the Mod configurator (mod settings menu). The archive already contains the settings library (modsSettingsApi) needed for that menu; without it the mod runs with default settings.

mods.title: BalCalcMod
mods.descriptionHtml:
BalCalcMod is a ballistic distance helper. It lets you lock the current aiming distance so your shells do not fly over a target that moves or hides behind cover.

Hold the lock key to keep the current distance to the target. After that the shell keeps the same range even if you move the crosshair up onto the sky, a ridge, or terrain behind the enemy, so it no longer flies over the target.

How to use it: set the correct distance first, then press and hold the lock key before the target disappears. Keep the crosshair on the point you want to hit and fire while holding the key. It is most useful against enemies that peek and quickly pull back behind hills, rocks or buildings. It works in sniper, arcade and artillery view.

Options:
• Lock key or mouse button (default Q)
• Distance indicator color, font, position and shadow
• Automatic lock when the crosshair is on a tank, with adjustable hold time (sniper view)
• Shell trajectory correction so the aim does not jump to maximum range when pointed at the sky
• Mouse wheel step for adjusting the locked distance in artillery view

All settings are available in the garage through the in-game Mod configurator (mod settings menu). The configuration is saved to %APPDATA%\Wargaming.net\WorldOfTanks\mods\Aslain\balcalc\BalCalc.json

This mod has been reviewed by Wargaming and confirmed as allowed. Using it cannot result in a ban.

Credits: original BalCalcMod by Evgeni Kiselev (ktod), later maintained by Ktulho. This GUI edition by Aslain.

mods.title: AutoAim Indication+
mods.descriptionHtml:
AutoAim Indication+ makes it easier to activate the game's standard auto-aim and shows its state on screen.

It adds no aimbot behavior. It only triggers the normal in-game auto-aim, and only on a target you are actively aiming at. Put your reticle (the center aiming point) on a spotted enemy so the game highlights it with the usual outline, and the mod then locks the standard auto-aim on that target. If the enemy is behind cover, or you cannot place your reticle on it to highlight it, the mod does nothing. It never aims at weak spots, never calculates lead, and never locks through obstacles.

A slider sets how long the mod keeps waiting for a highlighted target after you press the key (0 means until you toggle it off).

While auto-aim is active, an indicator near the center of the screen shows the state. It can display the name of the targeted tank or your own custom text.

Options:
• Toggle key to enable or disable the mod during battle
• Activation time (how long it waits for a highlighted target)
• Indicator text, color and font (several built-in game fonts)
• Indicator position (horizontal and vertical offset)
• Optional support for wheeled vehicles

All settings are available in the garage through the in-game Mod configurator (mod settings menu). The configuration is saved to %APPDATA%\Wargaming.net\WorldOfTanks\mods\Aslain\autoaimindication\AutoaimIndication.json

Because it only helps activate the standard auto-aim on a target in your line of sight and adds nothing beyond the vanilla aim lock, this mod complies with the Wargaming Fair Play Policy. It has been reviewed by Wargaming and confirmed as allowed, and using it cannot result in a ban.

Credits: original mod by Krzysztof Chodak; maintained over the years by OldSkool, RaJCeL, Ktulho, budyx69 and Heliomalt. Current version by Aslain.

mods.title: Legacy interface UI
mods.descriptionHtml:
Legacy Hangar UI Author: Renovo

Compatible Client Version: 2.3.0.0+ (World of Tanks 2.0)

Concept & Features

Tired of the new modern Gameface hangar and want to return to the classic nostalgic feeling? Legacy Hangar UI allows you to force the classic Flash-based (Scaleform) hangar interface inside World of Tanks 2.0!

With this mod, you can dynamically switch between the modern Gameface UI and the nostalgic classic Scaleform hangar on the fly:

Instant Toggling: Press Ctrl + I inside the hangar to instantly switch the interface between the classic Scaleform hangar and the modern Gameface hangar.

Classic Navigation: Restores the classic navigation buttons and elements to provide a visual look-alike of the old hangar UI layout.
Custom NavBar & Installation: The navigation menu has been added as a separate modification to give users full freedom of choice. If for any reason you do not wish to use it, please install only the LegacyHangar .wotmod file into your game client.

Important Note & Limitations

Mode Selector & Navigation: The game mode selector button is accessible directly within the top navigation menu.

No Promo Banners: Banners are completely removed and there are no plans to add them. If you need to check them out, you can find them in the Modern UI.

Platoon Creation: The "Create Platoon" button is located at the bottom of the screen, just like in the Modern UI.

Upgrade Menu for Tier XI: The Field Modification button works seamlessly for both Tier XI and lower-tier vehicles. For Tier XI, it opens the Upgrades menu, while for Tier X and below, it triggers the standard Field Modification menu.

If you need to view banners or adjust other settings using the new Gameface UI, simply press Ctrl + I to switch back to the modern interface on the fly, and then press it again to return to the classic hangar!

Please note that this mod only changes the visual appearance of the hangar interface itself. It does NOT restore the legacy style of other screens, such as the post-battle statistics window, store, storage, or other lobby views.

Known Issues

Pet System: Access to the Pet System does not function while in Legacy UI mode, making it impossible to claim Pet rewards due to Scaleform compatibility limitations. However, rewards and the Pet menu can still be accessed normally in the Modern UI. mods.title: Zanju's Research Progress Bar
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod adds a fully customisable progress bar which shows your progress in:

  • Module and vehicle research
    • See how close you are to researching modules and vehicles without entering any menu.
    • On tier X vehicles you can optionally show progress towards hypothetical future Tier 11 vehicles that might be added in the future.
  • Field modifications
    • See how close you are to unlocking each field modification level without entering any menu.
    • Each level shows what options are available, or will be available once unlocked.
    • Optionally the bar can stay displayed even after field modification research to quickly check what upgrade is selected without entering any menu.
  • Tier 11 upgrades system
    • See how close you are to unlocking next upgrade without entering any menu.
    • Still helpful to see overall progress, even though a flat progress bar cannot display the complex upgrade tree.
  • Elite level progress
    • See how close you are to reaching next elite badge style.
    • Shows progress towards cosmetic elements tied to elite level available for Tier 11 vehicles.
    • Optionally the bar can display progress towards elite level badges.

Other features of the mod:

  • Different XP types are taken into account:
    • Separate calculation for research using vehicle XP only. (Displayed in green)
    • Separate calculation for research using vehicle XP + free XP. (Displayed in yellow)
    • Elite level progress is calculated based on base XP.
  • Optional warning messages:
    • Research now! message when you have enough vehicle XP to research all available items.
    • Accelerate crew training! message when you have already researched all available items.

Issues Or Ideas

If you'd like to report a bug or other issue, or pass an idea or other feedback for the mod, you can do so on GitHub.

Source Code

Source code of the mod is public and is available on GitHub.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Simplest Installation Method

This is the easiest method if you already know where your World of Tanks game folder is.

  1. Copy the mod zip file into your main World of Tanks game folder.
  2. Right-click the zip file and choose Extract here.
  3. If Windows asks whether you want to replace existing files, choose yes or agree to all replacements.

The needed files should land in the correct places automatically because the zip already contains the right folder layout.

Manual Method: Extract Elsewhere First

Use this method if you want to look inside the zip before copying anything into the game.

  1. Extract the zip file somewhere else first, for example on your desktop.
  2. Open the extracted folder. You should see folders such as mods.
  3. Open your World of Tanks game folder in another window.
  4. Drag the extracted folders into the game folder.
  5. If Windows asks whether you want to merge folders with the same name, allow it.
  6. If Windows asks whether you want to replace files, allow that too.

mods.title: First Move
mods.descriptionHtml:
First Move displays a minimap heatmap overlay showing the most common opening routes for your current vehicle. Mod is aimed to support players who are sometimes not sure what initial paths to choose.

The heatmaps are generated from approximately 26,000 best battle replays from wot-record starting from 2.0 and are based on routes taken by players who achieved strong battle results. The mod helps you quickly understand where successful players typically deploy at the start of a match and which areas are most frequently contested. This is best effort, which means that for unpopular tanks some processed replays have lower masteries or in rare cases no overlay data is available. 

Features

  • Vehicle-specific heatmaps.
  • Opening route visualization directly on the minimap.
  • Based on real player battle data.
  • Lightweight in-game overlay.
  • Hotkey support.

Supported Vehicles

  • Light Tanks (Tier X–XI)
  • Medium Tanks (Tier X–XI)
  • Heavy Tanks (Tier X–XI)
  • Tank Destroyers (Tier X–XI)
  • • Popular premium tanks (Tiers VIII–IX)

Controls

  • Ctrl+H — Enable / Disable heatmap overlay.

In case of bugs or requests please contact me in Discord: dscorp

mods.title: Avalon's Caernarvon Mk. 2 'Bullpup' and Caernarvon Mk. 3 'Tornado'
mods.descriptionHtml:
• Pair of remodels for the tier 8 Caernarvon and Caernarvon AX heavy tanks. 
  • The Mk. 2 Caernarvon was one of ten tanks produced as a middle step between the FV201 and FV214 Conqueror. The mating of a Centurion Mk. 3 turret to the hull and running gear of FV214. The tank was armed with a 20-pdr OQF gun. This tank was sent to the British Army of the Rhine for trials and was eventually pressed into hurried service. It sports several additional modifications that were not standard issue in cluding the addition of a roof mounted .50-caliber machine gun and additional fuel reserves mounted to the rear of the tank. The tank was nicknamed 'Bullpup' by its crew, for its intermediate nature, being not a medium tank nor a true heavy tank.
  • The Mk. 3 Caernarvon was a proposed up armoring of the original six Caernarvon prototypes, using the mantletless Action X turret design. The addition of extra spaced armor onto the turret was considered after trials with a FV214 Conqueror were conducted that showed a marked improvment in overall protection of the tanks turret. This turret was never accepted into service, and 'Tornado' serves as the only one of its kind.
  • The above is not real. Its all flavour text. Will not modify the stats of the tank.

NOW UPDATED FOR RAMBO

Update 1.2 fixes issues with the event M103 being invisible

Themed around potential USMC M103A2 Deployment in Vietnam this M103 skin aims to be realistic adjacent, with yellow highlighting on parts of the tank and yellow marine corps lettering. A Fictional Skin that doesn't feel too removed from reality. 

This Style features the M60 Powerpack, added storage to the tank with a spare wheel, lit headlights, a Large Commander dual 50 Cal mount and much more.  

The Custom weathering changes the stock dust layer to a more orangish dirt layer for that Vietnam jungle feel. The Chassis and Tracks have their high friction areas rubbed clean of their extra dirt layer.  
Due to the custom weathering affects the procedural dirt acclamation is turned off for the main parts of the tank to keep the style intact throughout the battle.

mods.title: SpotMeter
mods.descriptionHtml:
SpotMeter adds a dynamic minimap circle showing distance from 
which your tank can currently be spotted, based on your real-time 
camouflage state. 

KEY FEATURES 

* Live spot-distance circle on the minimap, updated every 0.2s 
* Four colour states reflecting your current camo: 
   - Red        - moving 
   - Green      - still 
   - Dark green - still 3s+ with active camouflage net 
   - Orange     - approximately 3 seconds after firing (fire penalty) 
* Battle-time enemy picker (Numpad 8/2) re-scales the circle to a 
 SPECIFIC enemy tank's estimated view range 
* Five toggles (Numpad 7/3/4/1/0) for assumed enemy bonuses: 
   - Combat Rations           (+4.30% crew amplifier) 
   - Brothers in Arms         (+2.53% crew amplifier) 
   - Recon + Sit. Awareness   (+7.39% bundled) 
   - Directives on equipment  (x1.025 on auto-detected equipment) 
   - Field upgrades on VR     (BETA, per-tank lookup) 
* Coated Optics and Stereoscope are AUTO-DETECTED from the enemy's 
 vehicle descriptor - no manual toggle needed for equipment 
* Siege modes (CS-63, str's) automatically 
 handled via the engine's CompositeVehicleDescriptor 
* On-screen status overlay (Numpad 9) and full status snapshot 
 (NumpadEnter) printed to the in-battle chat channel 
* In-battle config reload (NumpadPeriod) for fast iteration 
* Numpad keys work with NumLock ON and OFF 

HOW IT WORKS 

The mod reads your vehicle's invisibility factors directly from the 
client's own type descriptor (turret camo, crew/equipment multipliers, 
optionalDevices). It uses the same formula as the game's 
scripts/common/items/utils.py:getInvisibility() to compute camo, then 
converts it to a spot radius via enemyViewRange * (1 - camo), clamped 
to 50-445m. 

Default enemy view range is your own VR (most realistic baseline). 
Override via the picker to model a specific opponent. 

CONFIGURATION 

Optional spotmeter.json in mods/configs/ tunes: 
* Every hotkey (numpad layout, configurable per key) 
* Circle colours, alpha, tick interval 
* All VR bonus multipliers (empirically calibrated on a 340m base VR 
 tank: Rations +14.62m, BIA +8.60m, Recon +9.79m, SitAware +15.33m) 
* Per-tank field upgrade table for tanks with VR upgrades in their 
 post-progression tree 

The mod works without a config too - sensible defaults built in. 

LIMITATIONS 

* Foliage / bush camo bonuses are computed via server-side raycasts 
 and are not modelled (out of scope) 
* Other players' crew perks, active consumables, and field upgrades 
 are server-private; the picker toggles let you model expected 
 enemy configurations rather than read real values 

SOURCE & SUPPORT 

Open source under MIT licence at github.com/M1ikus/spotmeter 
Full documentation, formula derivations, and the optional config file 
are available there. Issues and feedback welcome.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Copy spotmeter-vX.X.X.wotmod into your World of Tanks folder under latest
  mods/X.X.X.X/. The game loads it automatically on next launch. 

2. (Optional) Download spotmeter.json from github.com/M1ikus/spotmeter 
  and place it in mods/configs/ to customise hotkeys, colours, or VR 
  bonus values. The mod uses sensible defaults without it. 

3. Launch the game and enter a battle. A second minimap circle will 
  appear, showing your current spot distance. 

To uninstall: just delete spotmeter-vX.X.X.wotmod from mods/X.X.X.X/. 

For full hotkey reference, picker walkthrough, and the technical 
formula breakdown, see github.com/M1ikus/spotmeter.

mods.title: Mammothtank's Hull_Angle_Indicator
mods.descriptionHtml:
Hull Angle Indicator

Displays colored indicator bars left and right of the crosshair when the gun-hull angle exceeds a configurable threshold. Helps you keep track of your hull angle to avoid exposing weak spots or getting caught at bad angles.

Features:

  • Color-coded bars: green → orange → red based on angle
  • Configurable warning, pre-threshold and threshold angles
  • Maximum angle limit (bars disappear above a set angle)
  • 5 presets: Default, Thin, Medium, Thick, Custom, Off
  • Per-tank profile assignment via F10 panel in battle (Ö/Ä keys, semicolon and apostrophe on eng keyboards)
  • Full settings menu via Mod Configurator
  • Smooth fade-in/fade-out animation

How to use:

  1. Configure the default bar appearance and angle thresholds in the Mod Configurator (garage) or in the config file in your res_mods folder

    2. The other profiles besides the default profile can only be edited via the config file.
  2. In battle, press F10 to open the info panel
  3. Press Ö (previous) or Ä (next) (semicolon and apostrophe on eng keyboard) to cycle profiles for the current tank
  4. The profile is saved automatically per tank in the config file

Optional requirement for the garage config menu:

  • ModsSettingsApi by IzeBerg (v1.7+)

mods.title: Challenges
mods.descriptionHtml:
Allows you to play challenges with OR AGAINST your platoon mates

Do you want to play challenges with your platoon mates?

How about reaching 120k combined damage in 10 battles with two of your buddys?

With this mod you can do this. The values you achieved in battles are combined with the values of your platoon mates. HAVE FUN!

EXPLANATION WITH GAMEFACE

(Damage) races are only available if you use gameface, see the installation instructions to see, how to install gameface.

Start a challenge: Select if you want to play a race or in co-op, then select the stat to play the challenge/race with, enter the maximum amount of battles to reach the value in and finally the goal. Start the challenge

 

EXPLANATION WITHOUT GAMEFACE

Start a challenge: click any challenge (e.g. [1] 120k Combined Damage)
Cancel an active challenge: Click [Cancel] while a challenge is running
Edit challenge templates: Click [Edit challenges] to open challenges.json directly

Customizing challenge templates (challenges.json):

 Each entry has four fields:
 - name — display name
 - type — COMBINED, DAMAGE, KILLS, SPOTTING, SURVIVE or WINS
 - target — the goal value (e.g. 120000 for 120k damage)
 - max_battles — battle limit to reach the target

 Moving the overlay: Drag it anywhere you want

Error fixes: Delete the file to generate a new file with the standard challenges. Make sure there is a comma behind all entries EXCEPT THE LAST ONE

 Note: Challenges track progress across platoon battles — each platoon member's stats count to the combined progression except for wins and survived.

I always play challenges with my platoon mates, each of us has to pick a new random tank for each battle. If you are interested in that too, have a look at my other mod: Random Tank Picker

If you need help ask here: Z4imon's mods (Official WoT Discord)

made by Z4imon

mods.title: HD Icons of old tanks in hangar
mods.descriptionHtml:
WORK IN PROGRESS, MOD IS BEING IMPROVED
This mod replaces the SD icons of older tanks in the garage with HD versions, which are used in the Tankopedia.
That is, icons for tanks such as the IS-6, E 100, FV4202, and others, whose in-game models have been upgraded to HD quality, but whose icons, for some reason, were not redrawn in the game.
Answers to possible questions:
Does the mod replace the icons in the research tree?
- No, it was decided not to do this, as the new icons look grotesque in the tech tree, and it would take a lot of extra time to scale each tank.
Is icon replacement supported in the minimalist tank carousel?
- There is no support for the minimalist carousel yet; I will add it later.
How complete is the mod?
- Most tanks from Tier 8 to Tier 10 have been resized based on the scale of the original SD icons; most tanks from Tier 1 to Tier 7 require further refinement. As mentioned above, support for the minimalist carousel will be added in the future.
Please send feedback/suggestions via private messages on my Discord:
Discord: zachuhan.
I’d also like to mention that this mod is being developed by me alone, and the work takes a lot of time. Unfortunately, I don’t have an account with every tank to verify the scaling of each one, so if you’re sending feedback, please include a screenshot of the original icon and a screenshot of the icon in the mod for comparison.

mods.title: Armor ModPack
mods.descriptionHtml:
Armor Modpack is now available on WGMODS

One of the longest-standing projects in the tanking community has officially moved to wgmods.net. With over 10 years of development behind it, the modpack has built up a collection of unique features many of which you won’t typically find in other popular setups.

Armor Modpack focuses on functionality that goes beyond the usual “standard” bundles:

  • A full account manager with multi-login support, allowing you to switch accounts quickly without leaving the game.
  • An AFK indicator to spot inactive players, along with the Observers mod.
  • An incognito mode that lets you stream your favorite game without worrying about streamsnipers.
  • An in-game radio and colored wrecks of destroyed tanks, making it easier to navigate cluttered battlefields.

Overall, it’s a reliable and well-optimized option for players who want more than just updated sights offering specialized tools to enhance gameplay and fine-tune the client to their preferences.

If you have any questions about mods or settings, feel free to ask me on Telegram or Discord (buttons in the modpack)

If the author is not indicated, and the author wants to indicate it, please write to the Discord or Telegram channel and I will add it without any problems
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Installation:

  • Run the installer file.
  • Point it to your World of Tanks installation directory.
  • Select the desired mods and configuration options.
  • To modify your setup later, simply re-run the installer; your previous selections will be saved automatically.

Updating:

  • Keep the existing modpack installed — do not remove it.
  • Download and execute the latest installer version (your prior settings will be retained).
  • Follow the installation steps to complete the update.

Uninstallation:

  • Remove the modpack via Windows “Apps & Features” (Add or Remove Programs) in the Control Panel.

mods.title: Armor Penetration Calculator
mods.descriptionHtml:
For questions or mod support join the discord server.

If you want to support me: https://ko-fi.com/pademinune

Please ensure your in game reticle has an armor pen indicator. The numbers will not display without it

Overview

This mod displays the exact effective armor value, penetration probability, and angle of a tank you are aiming at.

How is this different from other effective armor mods found in modpacks?

They don't compute and display the exact probability of penetrating. You would have to estimate this in the moment based on your shell's penetration and their armor. This wastes crucial time and is very innacurate (especially since the distribution is not uniform).

What is the best way to use this mod?

Sometimes in battles, it is better to save your shot rather than taking a chance on an orange pen indicator. If you try to pen when you have a 20% chance, you will likely bounce and take a shot in return for nothing. Instead, it may be better to save your shot for a few seconds until you get a better opportunity.

Also, when aiming at a well armored tank, with this mod you can find the optimal spot to shoot that will maximize your chance of penning.

Features

  • Displays exact effective armor value following game mechanics
    • Shell-specific normalization
    • Ricochet angles
    • Gun caliber overmatching
    • Spaced armor
    • HEAT shell dissipation through spaced armor
  • Computes and displays probability of penetration
  • Displays the exact armor angle so that you know when to change angles to pen someone
  • Great performance since the mod uses the calculations already done by the game
  • Customize the mod to your liking by changing the settings

Config

There is a settings gui for the config you can edit in the garage.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Download unzip-me.zip.
  2. Put the zip file in your mods/x.x.x.x/ folder found in your local World of Tanks installation folder.
  3. Unzip and extract the .wotmod files into that folder.
  4. Launch World of Tanks and the labels will appear when looking at an enemy tank.

mods.title: Way to Valhalla
mods.descriptionHtml:
1)ENG 

2)UA 

1) This modpack is built around a functional minimalist approach for World of Tanks. It includes only tested and truly useful modifications that improve gameplay comfort and client performance. 

The pack contains essential interface elements such as the spotted indicator (Sixth Sense lamp), vehicle markers, HWM and other helpful battle interface mods. It also includes optimization tweaks and FPS-friendly modifications designed to improve performance, especially for lower-end PCs. 

A unique feature of the modpack is the voice-over from a Ukrainian streamer. This is one of the first Ukrainian streamer voice packs created specifically for World of Tanks. 

The modpack follows a strict balance principle: nothing unnecessary and nothing missing. All mods are compactly integrated, keeping the interface clean while improving gameplay comfort, stability and performance. 

2) Цей модпак створений у стилі функціонального мінімалізму для World of Tanks. У ньому присутні лише перевірені та дійсно корисні модифікації, які покращують зручність гри та продуктивність клієнта. 

У модпак входять необхідні елементи інтерфейсу: індикатор засвіту (лампочка), маркери техніки, HWM та інші моди, що допомагають швидше орієнтуватися в бою. Також присутні оптимізаційні модифікації та налаштування, спрямовані на підвищення FPS, що особливо корисно для слабших комп'ютерів. 

Особливістю модпаку є унікальна озвучка українського стримера. Це одна з перших озвучок українського стримера, створених спеціально для World of Tanks. 

Модпак зібраний за принципом строгого балансу: нічого зайвого, нічого відсутнього. Усі моди компактно інтегровані, не перевантажують інтерфейс і допомагають зробити геймплей зручнішим, стабільнішим і приємнішим.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Run the modpack installer. In the language selection window choose Ukrainian or English and press OK. In the next window press Next. 

On the first page it is recommended to select Full removal of installed modifications and Save selected settings. Then choose the mods you want to install. The main module and its dependent mods must be selected, otherwise some modifications may not work. 

On the next pages choose the additional mods you need. The pack includes a custom Sixth Sense indicator, efficiency panel and other useful gameplay mods. The automatic consumables activation mod is recommended. 

On the final page you can choose voice packs. It is recommended to install Voice Manager, which allows changing voice packs directly in the garage. 

After selecting everything press Next → Install → Finish. 

If you have any issues or questions about the modpack, contact Telegram support of the channel.

mods.title: Kill Chance Mod by Wilu88
mods.descriptionHtml:
A World of Tanks mod that displays the one-shot kill probability of the currently aimed **enemy** vehicle while in sniper mode.

## What does it show?

A yellow label appears below the sniper crosshair only when aiming at an **enemy vehicle** with HP greater than zero.

| Situation | Text shown | Example |
|---|---|---|
| One-shot kill possible | `KILL: XX%` | `KILL: 73%` |
| Guaranteed one-shot kill | `KILL: 100%` | `KILL: 100%` |
| Kill impossible (fixed) | `Shots to kill: X` | `Shots to kill: 3` |
| Kill impossible (range) | `Shots to kill: X-Y` | `Shots to kill: 2-3` |
| Rifled barrel + distance | same + distance | `KILL: 45% (234m)` |

## Known limitations

- Hull HP only — does not account for internal modules or crew
- Active shell index detection may fall back to the first shell in the magazine in some configurations

## Enjoying the mod?

If you find the mod useful and want to say thanks, you can buy me a coffee:

☕ ** https://buycoffee.to/wilu **
OR https://buymeacoffee.com/wilu ☕

Thank you for your support!

mods.title: Warm Classic Hangar
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod tweaks the  hangar visuals to feel warmer and more “classic”, inspired by the ~2012 World of Tanks vibe.

  • fog/haze: reduced cold blue tint, softer warmer atmosphere;
  • post-processing: toned down “cinematic” effects (weaker bloom/flare/rays), less overbright look;
  • sky/skybox: lower exposure and highlight burn, calmer sky colors;
  • volumetric fog disabled to avoid modern-looking rendering.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Installation (via res_mods):

  1. Close World of Tanks.
  2. Go to your game folder → res_mods\<client_version>\
    • Example: ...\World_of_Tanks\res_mods\1.xx.x.x\
  3. Copy the mod files keeping the original folder structure (create folders if needed).
  4. Launch the game.

mods.title: Yet Another Modpack
mods.descriptionHtml:
Yet Another Modpack

This modpack provides a curated selection of quality-of-life improvements and popular modifications for World of Tanks. It allows users to choose between Full setup, Сompact setup, Custom setup, or Preset: the_barbarian installation types. 

Key Components:

Battle Hits: A viewer to inspect where shots landed and penetrated after battle. 
Replays Manager: A dedicated tool for managing and organizing your game replays. 
Marks of Excellence (MoE): Tracks progress towards gun marks in battle (available variants: Lebwa, Protanki). 
Battle Equipment: Displays your current vehicle's equipment loadout directly on the battle interface.
Tomato.gg: Links your game client to the Tomato.gg website, giving you quick access to detailed player profiles, vehicle statistics, and automatic updates.
PMOD: A powerful all-in-one package that improves gameplay with session statistics, team HP bars, camera stabilization, and useful tweaks like handbrake on TDs.

mods.title: Commander Selector
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod allows you to use an in-game interface to select from a large list of commander voices. It does nothing to the crews you have in your tanks. It simply makes the commander voice you hear in battle be the commander that you have selected. You will hear the selected commander voice no matter what tank or nation you are playing. Commanders are organized by groups so they are easy to find. 

There is an option to randomly play commanders from a group (i.e. Vikings). One commander from this group can be excluded. Players can also activate a favorites option where up to five different commanders can be custom selected and will be played in rotation. 

Note: requires a garage mod settings UI handled by these files: 
- izeberg.modssettingsapi_1.7.0.wotmod 
- me.poliroid.modslistapi_1.7.8.wotmod 
- net.openwg.gameface_1.1.5.wotmod 

If you have either Aslain or ProMod installed, you should have the necessary UI files.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Download this .wotmod file and place it in the 'World_of_Tanks\mods\current version' folder on your PC.

Please report any bugs to loadfastermods@ gmail

mods.title: Be Quiet Fool!
mods.descriptionHtml:
Most of the time in the game, in my experience, when one of your teammates says to "Fall back!", they are doing it for selfish reasons. Because they don't want you in a bush that they wanted to be in, or they don't want you to get damage because they want to get that damage. This is really annoying. 

This mod is made to address that problem. The first option in the mod is to merely silence the person who tells you to retreat. It will instantly silence them for the rest of that match, but not blacklist them. The second option in the mod is to silence them immediately + add them to your blacklist. 

When another player is silenced, Mr. T will say, "Be quiet fool!" 

Note: requires a garage mod settings UI handled by these files: 
- izeberg.modssettingsapi_1.7.0.wotmod 
- me.poliroid.modslistapi_1.7.8.wotmod 
- net.openwg.gameface_1.1.5.wotmod 

If you have either Aslain or ProMod installed, you should have the necessary UI files.

mods.title: PanzerNews Core
mods.descriptionHtml:
PanzerNews Core – Map Rotation Telemetry Mod

PanzerNews Core is a lightweight World of Tanks client mod that automatically tracks which maps you play and in which battle modes, then sends this telemetry to the PanzerNews server for statistical analysis. The goal is simple: build accurate, real-world map rotation stats based on actual battles — not guesses.

What it does

Records played maps (by WoT map ID) with timestamps

Detects battle modes via WoT bonus type + gameplay (e.g. Standard/Encounter/Assault where available)

Identifies your region and cluster (EU1/EU2/EU3/EU4) to separate rotation stats per server

Prevents duplicates using the unique battle identifier (arenaUniqueID)

Works in the background with minimal performance impact

Why it’s useful

Map rotation changes over time and differs between modes and clusters. PanzerNews Core collects clean, structured data so PanzerNews can generate:

  • map frequency charts
  • rotation trends over time

Privacy & data

PanzerNews Core does not read your chat, replays, or personal files. Telemetry is limited to match/map/mode metadata plus a non-personal install ID used for deduplication. No usernames or account credentials are collected.

If you want real map rotation stats, PanzerNews Core is the missing piece.

Page with map rotation: Current Map Rotation

mods.title: Vehicle Reskin Renamer
mods.descriptionHtml:
Fix inconsistent and confusing reskinned tank names. This mod replaces all names of reskins with the base vehicle name + a configurable identifier across the garage and in battle.

FEATURES

  • Two renaming modes:
    • Skin initials - follows Wargaming's naming conventions closely
       Example: Jade Coil → GSOR 1008 JC
    • Custom suffix - configurable suffix, including the option for no suffix 
      Examples: Jade Coil → GSOR 1008* or Jade Coil → GSOR 1008
  • Includes all reskinned vehicles
  • In-game settings menu (via ModsSettingsApi; not required)
  • Short names optimized to avoid truncation in the team list in skin initials mode
    Example: Alembic → ASTRON R. A
  • Also changes full names to include the base vehicle name
  • Intercepts the name lookup system instead of  modifying game resource files, so it remains compatible across game version.

CONFIGURATION

Click the ⚭ button in the bottom right corner of the garage and choose Mod configurator to open the settings menu.
Note: Changes made will only apply after restarting the game. This is a game limitation.

Advanced users can also modify the JSON file in /mods/configs/breeeze directly. The file will automatically get generated on first launch.

CONTACT, FEEDBACK & BUG REPORTS

Mod thread on the World of Tanks Discord 

Discord DM: @breeeze.

In-game DM: breeeze

ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS

Thanks to:

  • CRUSHERX8 - for help with gathering vehicle data & testing, aswell as creating the cover image.
  • izeberg - for the ModsSettingsApi, enabling the in-game settings menu.
  • poliroid - for ModsList and OpenWG Gameface, to make ModsSettingsApi work.

mods.title: Pansy's Revamped Skies Volume 3
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod does not need updating for new patches (outside of when new maps are added or actual updates to the mod itself) and can simply be moved to the newest patch folder whenever WG Updates the game.
The mod also only fully works Improved Graphics (HD). While Standard Graphics will work, it will be missing the full features of the mod (namely the modified skyboxes) due to limitations.


Like my previous Revamped Skies mods, this mod includes changes to almost all available maps in the game, reworking map ambience and altering the skyboxes to give each map a new feel to it: this does NOT include event maps/hangars and will not. This includes:
- the default Hangar
- all 44 Random Battle maps
- all 3 Frontline maps

Here is an Imgur album showing a preview for every map: 
https://imgur.com/a/wot-revamped-skies-volume-3-mod-preview-y0pqnIN

If you like the mod, try checking out my other skybox mods:
- Revamped Skies Volume 1: https://wgmods.net/6868/
- Revamped Skies Volume 2: https://wgmods.net/7262/
- Aslain's Night Sky Edit: https://wgmods.net/7338/

If you are unsure which mod to use, or just like variety, I recommend trying out this mod: Skybox Randomizer https://wgmods.net/7494/

  • must include some "issues" for transparency:
    - Reflective surfaces (notably water) still mostly reflect the ORIGINAL map appearance. This can look funny but should be for the most part irrelevant (the only real exception to this is Glacier Night where the ice being reflective affects the setting quite a bit. I'm still happy with the look of the map but I want to make sure you're aware of this)
    - Ambient map effects such as Airfield's offshore lightning still happen despite the different settings and might look silly, but not something I could fix so you'll have to ignore it
    - Some maps feature rain as part of an experimental test. This reuses assets from the WT Game mode, as well as the probes folders taken from the Rainy Weather mod in Aslain's, credit to Aslain/Pharaon for that. I have also reused some assets from my Aslain's Night Sky Edit, so credit again to Aslain/Pharaon for those.
    - While not necessarily an issue I want to make sure you're aware that altering the feel of the map can potentially lead to some disorientation. Again I apologise for this in advance
    - Since this has been a constant issue: if you're running this with any other skybox mod (namely No Fog/Sun Glare in Aslain's), it WILL cause issues with the skybox. Do not try to run this alongside any other sky-related mod, or try to run both versions included at the same time

 

Again this mod is NOT intended as a replacement for the original Revamped Skies mod or the Volume 2 Version, but simply an additional rework of every map. You can comfortably swap between any of my Revamped Skies mod from time to time to change up the feel of the game.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
To install drag or extract the included .wotmod file into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\mods\2.1.1.0\[WOTMOD GOES HERE]

This mod should work fine even with new updates outside of new maps being added. Even with serious map redesigns it shouldn't run into any problems. If you want to preview it without launching into an actual battle you can always use the Topography Mode to preview a number of maps.

mods.title: Vehicle Reskin Renamer (DEPRECATED)
mods.descriptionHtml:
THIS MOD IS NOW DEPRECATED!

The mod will work for 2.1.1.0 and any further micropatches that don't add vehicles, so I have not yet de-listed it - however, it is no longer in development and will not receive updates. 

Please head to https://wgmods.net/7499/ and download this version instead, authored by Breeeze - it does the same thing, but much better, and doesn't break on new updates!

The premise of the mod

Vehicle Reskin Renamer, as the name suggests, renames vehicles that are reskins of existing vehicles to their original or existing versions, adding a small tag to indicate that the name is a specific reskin, with the overall goal of ensuring a consistent looking team list and avoiding confusion when identifying such vehicles. 

The mod is made up of two versions (examples provided in the images) – one long, and one short – with the long names being more descriptive, but risking (relatively unobtrusive) truncation in some situations, and the short names identifying reskins with an asterisk. 

For example:

  • Long: IS-3A Peregrine
  • Short: IS-3A*

mods.title: YaYa's tactical minimaps
mods.descriptionHtml:
YaYa's Tactical Minimap Mod: 

This mod is intended to give new and seasoned players a guide to map starting positions as well as some neat angles to leverage. It is strongly recommended to visit YaYa's Map Website (https://wotmapsbyyaya.com/) as each map has positional information and explanations that put everything into perspective. Should you have questions or give feedback, join our discord: https://discord.gg/D9z2m2Q7ka

Mod Usage Instructions

A hot-key combination has been created to rebind the default key (ALT) to another during battle: Press ENTER to open the chat and then press CTRL+SHIFT+K to activate key rebinding. A chat message will appear in your in-game battle chat. Once complete, the rebind is then stored in the mod’s xml file for future use.


Note: This procedure must be completed every time the mod is updated including if updating with Aslain’s mod.

Standalone Installation

Copy archive content into the mods folder of the game.
E.g.: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks_EU\mods

By default the Mod is set up to show all icons upon pressing the toggle. However, should you wish to turn off the icons, this can be done within the “yayatacticmap” xml located in the “\mods\configs\locastan” folder. Instructions are provided within the xml.

Map Preview images:  

Ruinberg, Erlenberg, Malinovka, Serene Coast and the Style Guide.

mods.title: EBR Cruise Retainer (Siege Switch)
mods.descriptionHtml:
For Support / Questions / Suggestions visit: https://discord.gg/DqZ8fuX43C

Support me on Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/c/Gravity_Assist

Keeps cruise/autospeed active for wheeled tanks (EBR line) during siege/travel mode switching so the vehicle continues moving without re‑pressing W.

Before (vanilla behavior):
When switching between travel and siege modes on wheeled vehicles (e.g., EBR 75/90/105), autospeed/cruise control is canceled during the switch. Even if the cruise indicator is on, the vehicle stops unless you press W again.

After (with this mod):
If cruise/autospeed was active, the mod restores it immediately after the siege/travel switch and re-applies movement input, so the vehicle continues moving through the mode change without needing to press W again.

What it is:
Cruise control is the game’s “auto‑speed” system that keeps your tank moving without holding W/S. Internally it’s treated as its own input mode with separate commands for increasing or decreasing the cruise setting (forward/backward cruise).

How R / F relate to it:
The keybindings for cruise control are exposed as Forward Cruise and Backward Cruise commands in the keyboard bindings (commonly mapped to R to increase and F to decrease, depending on your setup). These are the bindings the game uses for cruise control speed steps.

Short Demo Video:

mods.title: PTZ-78 Booster Rebind
mods.descriptionHtml:
For Support / Questions / Suggestions visit: https://discord.gg/DqZ8fuX43C

What this mod does

This mod forces the PTZ-78 staged jet boosters (special ability) to use only the key you choose, without affecting other tanks. When you enter battle in the PTZ-78, it temporarily remaps the Special Ability command to your configured key and updates the in-battle hotkey display to match. When you leave the PTZ-78, your original keybinds are restored.

Notes

- The mod only changes the PTZ-78 boosters key. Other vehicles keep your normal bindings.

- The mod also updates the in-battle hotkey UI to show the configured key while using PTZ-78 boosters.

mods.title: Cellonty`s Battle Pack
mods.descriptionHtml:
Cellonty’s Battle Pack — Author’s Mod Collection

Cellonty’s Battle Pack is a functional mod pack assembled for personal use and shared with those who appreciate my approach to the game.

This pack doesn’t contain hundreds of useless scripts. It includes only the mods that the author considers helpful for effective gameplay. The collection is focused on interface clarity and visual comfort without unnecessary “clutter.”

🛡️ Pack Features

Author’s Choice: Only essential mods, tested in battles.

Convenient Installer: Preview support (see how a mod looks before installing), language selection, and automatic detection of the game path.

Clean Installation: Automatic cleaning of mods and res_mods folders to prevent conflicts.

No Bloat: The pack is not overloaded with heavy graphical mods that could interfere with gameplay.

📦 Mod Pack Contents

Combat Interface & Visuals:

White Outlines: Destroyed tanks and knocked-out tracks are highlighted in white for better visibility.

Battle Hits: View hits in the garage after battle.

Effective Armor: Displays real armor thickness, considering the angle of fire.

Distance to Target: Additional range indicator.

Danger Traffic Light: Visual threat indicator during battle.

Starry Sky: Cosmetic sky texture replacement.

Garage & Statistics:

XVM: Basic set of statistics and interface functions.

Armor Analysis: View tank penetration zones in the garage.

3 Marks: Monitor percentage to mark directly in battle or garage.

Replay Manager: Quick access to battle replays from the client.

Dismantling: Simplified equipment management.
mods.installationGuideHtml:

Run the installer

Select the installation language: Available options include Russian, Ukrainian, English, Polish, and others.

Game path: The installer will try to automatically locate your World of Tanks folder (supports Wargaming and Steam versions).

If the path is incorrect, specify it manually — the root folder of the game where WorldOfTanks.exe is located.

Component selection:

Use “Cellonty’s Choice” to install the recommended set.

Or select “Custom Installation” to mark only the mods you need.

Preview: Click “Show Preview” to see a screenshot of the mod before installing it.

Clean installation: It is recommended to keep the “Clean mods and res_mods folders” option checked to avoid conflicts with other mods.

Install: Click “Install” and wait for the process to complete.

mods.title: Skill4ltu Mod
mods.descriptionHtml:
Skill4ltu Mod (Official)

The official Skill4ltu Mod adds advanced battle analytics and tight integration with Skill4ltu Index. Install it, play battles, and unlock deep per-battle insights, extended scoreboards, and powerful progression tracking directly on your Skill4ltu Index profile.

Key features

  • Skill4ltu Index integration: a quick-access button in the WoT garage next to each tank to open its rating, recommended equipment, crew layout, field mods, and detailed specs.
  • Recent Battles: full battle timeline with personal score, team score, detailed report, and shot-by-shot visualization.
  • Battle Hits (3D): replay every shot you fired and every shot received in a 3D viewer with key context such as penetration chance, aim/dispersion circle size at the moment of firing, and impact details.
  • Matchmaker analytics: tier distribution and trends for each vehicle.
  • Economy breakdown: credits earned, costs, and net profit per vehicle and over time.
  • Marks tracking: Marks of Excellence, Marks of Mastery, and MoE progress charts.
  • Enhanced scoreboard: expanded per-player stats (damage, assists, stuns, capture/defense, credits, survival).

How it works

  1. Install the mod.
  2. Play battles with the mod enabled.
  3. Log in to Skill4ltu Index via the official Wargaming API to see the new analytics tabs in your profile.

mods.title: RenoDX - HDR - Bloom - Color Grade for World of Tanks
mods.descriptionHtml:
A mod using RenoDX that rewrites multiple shaders to allow control over bloom and color grading, as well as unclamping the output from SDR to real HDR. It uses the ReShade Add-on API to hook into the game, NOT RESHADE EFFECTS.

General:

3 customizable presets with an "Off" preset for comparisons.

  • Realtime sliders
  • Shader based color grade tools, allows adjustment of the game's final image without affecting the UI.
  • Bloom intensity slider.

Tone Mapper:

  • RenoDRT Tone Mapper - Preserves the game's original look with proper tone scaling and hue preservation.
  • Peak Brightness Slider - Defines peak HDR brightness in nits, should be adjusted according to your display.
  • Game Brightness Slider - Sets the value of 100% white in nits. This is the game's SDR brightness value, or "paper-white" value. Defaults to 203 nits.
  • UI Brightness Slider - Sets the peak brightness of all UI elements in nits. Defaults to 203 nits.

Scene Grading:

  • Scene Grading - Adjusts scene grading as applied by the game.
  • Saturation Correction - Corrects unbalanced saturation from per-channel grading.

Color Grading:

  • Exposure
  • Highlights
  • Shadows
  • Contrast
  • Saturation
  • Highlight Saturation
  • Blowout - Controls highlight desaturation due to overexposure.
  • Flare - Flare/Glare compensation.

Effects:

  • Bloom Slider - Allows adjustment of the bloom intensity.

Notes

Due to the way the game draws to the swapchain, some post process effects currently do not work with this mod. These include antialiasing when set to high, the sharpen filter when antialiasing is set to max, sniper optic effects and in-game color filters. These shaders have been disabled in the mod to avoid graphical issues that would make the game unplayable, but I would suggest loading into training or topography mode just to make sure there are no issues before going into a real match.

About RenoDX

RenoDX, short for "Renovation Engine for DirectX Games", is a toolset to mod games. Currently it can replace shaders, inject buffers, add overlays, and write user settings to disks. Because RenoDX uses Reshade's add-on system, compatibility is expected to be pretty wide. Using Reshade simplifies all the hooks necessary to tap into DirectX without worrying about patching version-specific exe files. The source code is available on GitHub.

Support Me

If you'd like to support me, you can do so at my Ko-Fi. You can also support the creator of RenoDX, ShortFuse, here.
If you have any questions or need help, I'm more than happy to assist, just leave a message in the Discord thread mentioned earlier.

Credits

﻿A big thanks to ShortFuse and Marat who helped me find my footing with RenoDX, as well as the RenoDX dev community as a whole for being very kind, helpful and knowledgeable in all things HDR.

Lilium for making the HDR analysis tool, which is extremely helpful for doing anything HDR related.

Video Preview

Screenshots
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Installation is pretty straightforward if you've ever used ReShade before. If you have any issues, feel free to join RenoDX Discord server and let me know in the "World of Tanks" forum thread in the "mods" forum.﻿ Also, feel free to update ReShade if there is an update available, RenoDX mods rarely break with ReShade updates.

  1. Extract "renodx-worldoftanks-wgmods.7z" and place both files (dxgi.dll and renodx-worldoftanks.addon64) under "\World of Tanks\region\win64." No ReShade effects are required.
  2. Run game.
  3. Press HOME on your keyboard to access the ReShade UI. If installed correctly you should see a tab labeled "RenoDX."

mods.title: Responsive Reticle
mods.descriptionHtml:
A mod that increases client reticle tick rate several dozen times.

Basically reduces input lag of client reticle from 100 ms to 1 ms.

Notes

  • disabled for SPG because ... it's complicated
  • disabled for hull-controlled tanks (like Strv 103B)
  • disabled in replays
  • has some smaller impact on FPS due to more frequent reticle position updates

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

FAQ

1. Should I have disabled "Use server aim" in game settings for responsive reticle?

  • Increased responsiveness works only for disabled server aim - so only for client reticle.
  • It does work correctly with mods displaying both client and server reticle - with this mod affecting client reticle.

2. If I have enabled "Use server aim", does this mod affects server reticle in any way?

  • Mod has only subtle side-effect on server reticle, by making its movement slightly more consistent due to faster client-side tick rate - but it's nothing spectacular, barely visible.

3. Does this mod affects game performance?

  • Due to increased reticle position update frequency, it may lower FPS a little bit, but on good PC it is a very good trade-off for very noticeable reticle responsiveness.

4. I'm playing SPG and Strv tanks, but I don't see increased reticle responsiveness, why?

  • Mod is disabled for Strv tanks due to them controlling reticle by hull movement - and hull movement is server side, which cannot get increased responsiveness from this mod.
  • It is also disabled for SPG due to it being buggy in top-down view. Also this mod is not useful for SPG, so the easiest compromise was to just disable this mod for them.

Source code & Feedback

Source code is on my Github repository.

You can:

  • PM me on discord: fierioziy (nick: Pruszko [EU] on WoT official discord)
  • in game on EU server: Pruszko

mods.title: Playlist Sync
mods.descriptionHtml:
✨ Features

Automatic Cloud Sync
Your playlists upload instantly whenever you create, edit, rename, or delete one.

Cross-PC Consistency
No more losing playlists when you switch computers or reset your game files.

Instant Restore After Login
The mod fetches your saved playlists and applies them as soon as your account loads.

Non-intrusive & Safe
The mod disables the built-in remote sync to prevent conflicts and uses a custom external API instead.

Lightweight & Fast
Uses efficient JSON sync with a short timeout to avoid hanging the client.

🔧 How It Works

- Each account is identified by its database ID.
- Your playlists are stored on an external server.
- When you log in, the mod checks for your saved playlists and restores them automatically.
- Any changes you make are re-uploaded in the background.

📌 Notes

No personal data other than your player ID and playlist contents is transmitted.

👍 Recommended For

- Players using multiple computers
- Users who reinstall or clean their client often
- Competitive players who maintain large playlist setups
- Anyone who wants persistent, hassle-free vehicle playlist management

For Support / Questions / Suggestions visit: https://discord.gg/DqZ8fuX43C

❄️ Winter Mod 2025 – Comprehensive Winter Overhaul

The goal of Winter Mod 2025 is to deliver a complete and unified winter atmosphere across all major game modes and locations. Many maps have already been tested, and the mod provides a significant visual enhancement for players.

🌨️ Winterized Maps and Game Modes

The mod transforms the following areas into winter environments:

All Random Battle Maps
Full winter terrain, snow-covered ground, frosted vegetation, icy lighting conditions, and cold-toned skies.

Steel Hunter Maps
Winter textures, frozen terrain and a cold atmosphere, while preserving the original layout and gameplay.

Frontline Maps
Extensive snow coverage, winter-themed urban zones, and clear, cold lighting.

🏠 Winter Garage and Garage Switcher

The mod includes a garage switcher that allows players to swap from the new factory-style garage back to the classic snowy garage.
This feature works independently and is compatible with most garage-related mods.

🔧 Testing Status and Known Deviations

The mod has undergone extensive testing, but a full check of every map is still in progress.
Based on the current status:

Certain outland skin areas may not be fully perfected on a few maps.

Some rocks may still display partial moss textures instead of full winter coverage.

A few original skins have not yet been winterized — these will be updated in future releases.

These minor inconsistencies do not affect gameplay, and the majority of maps already deliver the intended winter atmosphere.

🧭 Winter-Themed Minimap Updates

All affected maps include winterized minimaps, visually matching the newly updated environments.

mods.title: Aslain's Night Sky Edit
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod does not need updating for new patches (outside of when new maps are added or actual updates to the mod itself) and can simply be moved to the newest patch folder whenever WG Updates the game.

This mod is an edit to the Night Sky mod found in Aslain's Modpack. While this mod functions standalone without requiring you to use Aslain's, I feel obliged to state that this is NOT my original mod.

 

This mod takes Aslain's Night Sky mod and, as the name implies, edits the lighting settings of the maps to better fit the night aesthetic. The lighting may still feel brighter than you'd expect night to be but I wanted maps to be somewhat playable. This affects the following maps:
- the default Hangar
- all 44 Random Battle maps
- all 3 Frontline maps

Here is an Imgur album showing a preview for every map: 
https://imgur.com/a/wot-aslains-night-sky-edit-v1-3-svnsvzU

If you like the mod, try checking out my other skybox mods:
- Revamped Skies Volume 1: https://wgmods.net/6868/
- Revamped Skies Volume 2: https://wgmods.net/7262/
- Revamped Skies Volume 3: https://wgmods.net/7490/

If you are unsure which mod to use, or just like variety, I recommend trying out this mod: Skybox Randomizer https://wgmods.net/7494/ 

 

Some final notes:
- This mod SHOULD work with SD/Simplified HD Graphics. Simplified graphics however have a bit of scuff with water appearance. I've done all I can do make it work but on some maps it will look off
- I shouldn't have to say this but I want to make it clear: this mod is dark. This will likely lead to some disorientation at first and will likely be uncomfortable for those with poor eyesight. Please keep that in mind. An optional mod has been included that may help with this and I highly recommend my Actual Lights mod alongside this one
- Various ambient map effects may stand out as jarringly bright compared to the overall lighting. Unfortunately I do not know a way to fix this while maintaining the appearance, I apologise for this
- Aslain's original Night Sky mod edits various event mode maps as well. I have however removed them (with v1.3) and chosen not to include them since I cannot test them and maintaining event maps that may never return just increases mod size
- do not attempt to run this with any other skybox mod (namely No Fog/Sun Glare in Aslain's), it WILL cause issues and cause the mod to not function as intended
mods.installationGuideHtml:
This mod features two different installation options:
wotmod version: drag or extract the included .wotmod file into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\mods\2.0.0.1\[WOTMOD GOES HERE]

Do NOT run the wotmod version alongside Aslain's original Night Sky.

res_mods version (ideal if you are already using Night Sky from Aslain's, allow it to replace all existing files): drag or extract the included "spaces" folder into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "res_mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\res_mods\2.0.0.1\[FOLDER GOES HERE]

-maps now use probes folder edits to try to make them more consistent. This still varies based on things like sun position but should be less jarringly different than before
-added a Hangar edit and preview album for each map
-added optional Night Light mod

第三弾はあんこうチームのムードメーカーで恋に恋する通信手、武部沙織さんの声です！

This third instalment features the voice of Saori Takebe, the Ankou Team's mood-maker and communications officer who's head over heels in love!


 

Installing this Character Voice Pack will replace all in-game combat audio in World of Tanks with Saori Takebe's voice.


 

Please note: This Character Voice Pack contains entirely new, specially recorded dialogue and sound effects. Furthermore, it is completely free for anyone to install, allowing everyone to enjoy Tankery alongside Saori Takebe with ease.


 

The third instalment of the Character Voice Pack, ‘Saori Takebe’, can be downloaded from the official World of Tanks forum.

mods.title: Crew Incomplete text-overlay removed and others shortened (German menu!) by Etzkiller
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod is inspired by the 'Crew Incomplete' text-overlay removed by Krautjaeger. 
https://wgmods.net/643/  
This is my first mod, so thx Krautjaeger for the instructions. 

This is a simple mod that removes and/or shortens some texts for the carousel overlay in the garage, for the German menu. 
I liked the mod from Krautjaeger but the in-game menu will change to English, and I liked to change some other overly long messages as well to see the tank names again.  

Also, the icon removal in the GUI from the Krautjaeger mod did not work for me.  
Maybe the icon name is different in the German installation? I might try to change that in a later update too. 


I made 2 version:  

V1.05_1 with text 
  
- Removing the text 'Besatzung unvollständig' so there will be only the icon. 
- Shorter texts for common things like 'Mietzeitraum abgelaufen', 'Ungeeignet für der Modus', and  'Munition unvollständig'. 
- Changing the text on the TS-54 if you do not have WoT-Plus. 

V1.05_2 no text 
  
- Without texts, only symbols for the most common messages. 


This mod may not be compatible with other mods that edit and include text-files under 'text\lc_messages', especially if they edit the file 'menu.mo'.  
If you have mods installed that do not edit this particular file but other files under 'text\lc_messages', this should be fine. 


--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


If you want to edit 'menu.mo' yourself, in the event that this file is needed for other mods and is already present in the res_mods folder,  
you can use a hex editor and search for these entries. 


For the German 'menu.mo' file, it seems all messages are in 
row 391: in Notepad++  

or in a hex editor, it is: 

last entry 4/4 
Besatzung unvollstÃ¤ndig (24 characters) 
Besatzung unvollständig -> [                        ]  24x space  

last entry 3/3 
Mietzeitraum abgelaufen (23 characters) 
Mietzeitraum abgelaufen -> [Miete beendet          ] 

entry 3 of 4!!! 
Munition unvollstÃ¤ndig (23 characters)    
Munition unvollständig -> [     No Amo!           ] 

just 1 entry 
Ungeeignet fÃ¼r den Modus (25 characters) 
Ungeeignet für den Modus -> [7vs7 Modus               ] 

just 1 entry for the TS-54 message 
Beendet (7 characters) 
Beendet -> [WoTPlus] 

As an example, you can edit it in hex and put '20' (hex-number for space) for each of the letters, then save.  
Or just type new characters in the decoded text depending on the editor you got. 
Just try not to mess up the layout, and have fun.
