mods.title: VoiceOverriderNG
mods.descriptionHtml:
Freely select the voices you want to hear in the tank. You may configure so no voices are heard, or only those of a given country. Activate the voices of your favorite commanders and the frequency you want them to be used with any tank.

"New Generation" for Yury Polyacov's PYmods VoiceOverrider, renamed so the overhauled version doesn't collide with the OG VoiceOverrider.

Enhancements

  • Feature: Instead of allowing to chose only one voice that will be globally used on every battle, allow for the use of up to 20 alternative voices, which are changed randomly before every battle. The selection uses a user-provided weight distribution, all configurable in-game so you can have certain voices more often than others.
  • Feature: The national voice for each country can be manually selected as a voice option.
  • Feature: Special voice selections and filters: "None (Silent)" option disables (mutes) the voices, or get a random female or male voice, or "do nothing" (no override) mode, or use default voices and limit the voice selection to those consistent with the playing tank's nation.
  • Feature: Sometimes a voice may sound cool but we don't know to which commander it belongs. An icon with the portrait of the active commander can be enabled, featuring to which voice you are listening. You can drag the icon around and put it wherever you find it convenient. It can be disabled from the configuration screen if you find it clutters the screen.
  • Enhancement: There's an option that allows to show the commander's portrait only while a special key is pressed (such as Alt, the default).
  • Feature: Option to not override the commander's voice if it has its own voice (meaning, only change the voice if the commander is "generic").
  • Feature: A "Round Robin" synthetic mode that instead of choosing at random, sequentially selects every available voice.
  • Feature: Use the game's internals to probe available voices and add those missing from VoiceOverrider's list, allowing for newly added voices or other voice mod's to appear at the end of the selector lists.
  • Feature: To make it easier to find the desired voice, options are now better grouped and sorted, and are graphically marked with a flag of the language/country they belong to, plus a female mark if it is the case.
  • Enhancement: Better grouping for "bloggers", or community leaders, so they can be found easier. Some voices wre grouped using prefixes that are a bit cryptic so they were removed or simplified or sent to the end of the string so they don't affect grouping.
  • Update: (from the last published version from PYmods repo) Support all of the voices included up to 2.0.1.0 (latest as of 10/14/2025, includes HW 2025 commanders and crews and GuP Kay)
  • Fix: Tweaks to voice names and removed typos.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
The usual: just extract the contents of the zip file inside the mods directory of your WoT installation.

Find the configurator inside the Mods / PYMods menu in the lower right corner. Check the "i" tooltips for hints on how to use the controls.

files.changeLog:
Bug fix release:
* Reassigned langs/nations of some Girls und Panzer voices.
* Don't show commander icon on event modes (such as Babylon, Steel Hunter)
* Keep commander icon position inside the screen at all times, in case there's a switch in resolution.
Updated to WoT 2.0.1.0, including the new voiceovers for the HW2025 season.

Update with latest voices and a couple of new features:

* Feature: Option to not override the commander's voice if it has its own voice (meaning, only change the voice if the commander is "generic").

* Enhancement: There's an option that allows to show the commander's portrait only while a special key is pressed (such as Alt, the default).

* Update: Support for all of the voices included up to 2.0.0.2 (latest as of 10/09/2025, includes Wolfenstein special Battle Pass cast)

* Update: Added missing library wotmod net.openwg.gameface_1.1.5.wotmod
Updated to latest OpenModsCore for 2.0 support.

Small update with refinements for the in-battle commander icon:

* The icon now shows with the flag of the nation the voice belongs to as a background behind the portrait.
* The name of the commander has a shorter version for the icon: just enough for you to identify it in the setting screen selectors.
* If your tank gets killed, the icon disappears after 3 seconds.
* A nice surprise for some commanders during the holidays season.

New main feature: in-battle draggable icon portraying the currently selected voice.

A lot of testing was performed after an important code reorganization / refactoring that was needed with the added complexity introduced by the new feature.

mods.title: Pansy's Revamped Skies Volume 2
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod does not need updating for new patches (outside of when new maps are added or actual updates to the mod itself) and can simply be moved to the newest patch folder whenever WG Updates the game.
The mod also only fully works Improved Graphics (HD). While Standard Graphics will work, it will be missing the full features of the mod (namely the modified skyboxes) due to limitations.


Like the original Revamped Skies, this mod includes changes to almost all available maps in the game, reworking map ambience and altering the skyboxes to give each map a new feel to it: this does NOT include event maps/hangars and will not. This includes:
- the default Hangar
- all 44 Random Battle maps
- all 3 Frontline maps

Here is an Imgur album showing a preview for every map: https://imgur.com/a/wot-revamped-skies-volume-2-mod-preview-RYMHj24

If you like the mod, try checking out my other skybox mods:
- Revamped Skies Volume 1: https://wgmods.net/6868/
- Revamped Skies Volume 3: https://wgmods.net/7490/
- Aslain's Night Sky Edit: https://wgmods.net/7338/

If you are unsure which mod to use, or just like variety, I recommend trying out this mod: Skybox Randomizer https://wgmods.net/7494/

I must include some "issues" for transparency:
- Reflective surfaces (notably water) still mostly reflect the ORIGINAL map appearance. This can look funny but should be for the most part irrelevant
- Ambient map effects such as Airfield's offshore lightning still happen despite the different settings and might look silly, but not something I could fix so you'll have to ignore it
- like Himmelsdorf in the original Revamped Skies, (small) Ensk seems to have a lighting issue that requires you to enter sniper mode to make the map use the correct lighting. I have no idea why this happens or how to actually fix it, but yeah, just entering sniper mode will correct it
- While not necessarily an issue I want to make sure you're aware that altering the feel of the map can potentially lead to some disorientation. Again I apologise for this in advance
- Since this has been a constant issue: do not try to run this alongside any other sky-related mod, including the other version within the mod. It WILL cause conflicts as the game tries to load both mods

 

As a final note, this mod is NOT intended as a replacement for the original Revamped Skies mod, but simply an alternate take on every map. You can comfortably continue using the original mod if you aren't a fan of this one, or change between the two to try to make the game feel a bit more fresh.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
To install drag or extract the included .wotmod file into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\mods\1.29.1.0\[WOTMOD GOES HERE]

This mod should work fine even with new updates outside of new maps being added. Even with serious map redesigns it shouldn't run into any problems. If you want to preview it without launching into an actual battle you can always use the Topography Mode to preview a number of maps.

mods.title: Winter/Holiday UI
mods.descriptionHtml:
🇭🇺 Magyar:
Ez a modleírás magyarul olvasható, az angol verzió pedig lejjebb görgetve található.

🇬🇧 English:
This mod description is available in Hungarian above, and in English further down—just scroll below.

🇭🇺 Magyar:

🎄 World of Tanks – Holiday/Winter UI Mod – Leírás ❄️

Ez a mod egy teljes ünnepi és téli hangulatot varázsol a World of Tanks játékfelületére. A cél egy barátságosabb, ünnepi atmoszféra megteremtése volt, amely nemcsak esztétikailag feldobja a játékélményt, de egy kis nosztalgiát és melegséget is visz a tankcsaták közé.

🔧 Főbb jellemzők:

🌌 Téli háttér: Az összes főmenü (garázs, küldetések, értékelések, barakk, csatamód választó stb.) friss, havas, éjszakai tájat kapott, karácsonyi fényekkel és díszítésekkel.

🎁 Ünnepi ikonok és elemek: Ajándékdobozok, koszorúk, szalagok és más karácsonyi motívumok jelennek meg az interfész különböző részein.

🌟 Dizájn összhang: A színpaletta, betűtípusok és díszítő elemek harmonizálnak a téli témával, így az egész UI egységes és stílusos marad.

🕯️ Karácsonyi hangulatú értékelő trófea: A teljesítménytrófea ünnepi dekorációt kapott, hóval borított tankkal a tetején és karácsonyi díszítéssel.

🧰 További részletek:

A mod kompatibilis a legtöbb UI elemmel, a napi küldetésektől kezdve egészen a járművek statisztikáiig.

Nem befolyásolja a játékmenetet vagy a teljesítményt.

A mod teljes mértékben vizuális, így használata nem sérti a Wargaming szabályzatát.

🎮 Ajánlott felhasználás: Ez a mod ideális minden játékos számára, aki szeretne kicsit ünnepibb hangulatban tankozni, legyen szó alkalmi játékosról vagy veterán harcosról.

🎄 World of Tanks – Holiday/Winter UI Mod – Description ❄️

This mod brings a full festive and winter-themed atmosphere to the World of Tanks interface. Designed to add a cozy, seasonal feel, it transforms your garage and menus into a winter wonderland—perfect for holiday gaming sessions.

🔧 Main Features:

🌌 Winter Backgrounds: All main UI screens (garage, missions, stats, barracks, battle mode selection, etc.) feature snowy landscapes, glowing lights, and winter night skies.

🎁 Holiday Icons & Elements: Gift boxes, wreaths, ribbons, and other Christmas-themed visuals decorate the interface across multiple panels.

🌟 Unified Festive Design: The color palette, fonts, and UI accents match the winter theme, creating a seamless and stylish experience.

🕯️ Holiday-Themed Trophy Display: The achievement trophy is decorated with snow, ornaments, and a holiday tank statue, enhancing the season’s spirit.

🧰 Additional Info:

The mod is compatible with most interface elements, including daily missions, battle results, collections, and stats.

No performance impact or gameplay changes.

Fully visual-only mod, safe to use under Wargaming’s fair play policy.

🎮 Perfect For: Any player looking to enjoy their tank battles with a warm festive touch—whether you're a casual commander or a seasoned veteran.

mods.title: Aim Pro: Monitor Distance Sensitivity
mods.descriptionHtml:
Calculates the sensitivity for sniperMode from the multiplier (slider in settings) of arcadeMode. The sniperMode multiplier is ignored.

The multiplier(slider in settings) arcadeMode adjusts the sensitivity for both arcadeMode and sniperMode, creating scalability of sensitivity on the monitor when changing FoV(Arcade, Zoom x2, etc).

How it works

Aspect ratio is the ratio between the width and height of the screen

MDV - does not depend on aspect ratio

MDH - directly dependent on aspect ratio

There are 7 methods to choose from:

  • Focal Length ( Recommended for everyone ) - MDV(H) 0% - means that the speed of tracking a moving target will be the same
  • Jedi's Trick - this method is using the average 360 distance between MDV 0% and MDV 100% for the conversion
  • MDV 100% - this is exactly the same as the MDH, but is instead using the vertical FOV
  • MDV 133% - this is exactly the same as the MDH, but is instead using the vertical FOV
  • MDH 60% - means moving the crosshair to aim at 60% of the distance between the crosshair and the edge of the monitor is the same
  • MDH 75% - means moving the crosshair to aim at 75% of the distance between the crosshair and the edge of the monitor is the same
  • MDH 100% - will match the movement to aim at something at the edge of the monitor

Example from popular games:, with multiplier "1":

  • CS2(CS:GO) - MDV 133%
  • RUST - MDV 100%
  • VALORANT - MDH 100%
  • Apex Legends - Focal Length(0%)

Example of sensitivity calculation with mod in WoT:

arcadeMode sensitivity = 1; sniperMode = Zoom: x2, x4, x8;

Zoom = sniperMode sensitivity

note: the sensitivity values x2, x4, x8 are not for “preferences.xml” but for demonstration

Focal Length

  • x2 = 0.47180057
  • x4 = 0.232665
  • x8 = 0.11593625

Jedi's Trick

  • x2 = 0.485491
  • x4 = 0.241021
  • x8 = 0.1202975

MDV 100%

  • x2 = 0.5
  • x4 = 0.25
  • x8 = 0.125

MDV 133%

  • x2 = 0.518795
  • x4 = 0.2620565
  • x8 = 0.131372

MDH 60%

  • x2 = 0.503505
  • x4 = 0.252216
  • x8 = 0.126108

MDH 75%

  • x2 = 0.518795
  • x4 = 0.2620565
  • x8 = 0.131372

MDH 100%

  • x2 = 0.547274
  • x4 = 0.281204
  • x8 = 0.14161825

How to use

  • Adjust the arcadeMode sensitivity using the slider in the game settings

or

  • Adjust sensitivity by multiplier in the “preferences.xml” file at the path:
  1. Go to %APPDATA%\wargaming.net\WorldOfTanks
  2. Edit preferences.xml
  3. Change <sensitivity> in <arcadeMode>
  4. Save your changes

or

  • Sensitivity setup for aim-mode

Features

  • Does not require updating for the game version
  • Works without API

Compatibility

  • This mod should be compatible with almost everything

Source code

Mod is not obfuscated and it's source code is on Github repository

Contributions

Thanks to:

  • Pruszko - for the implementation of the code

For nerds

  • Conversion method guide. (and other FAQ's)
  • Error Mathematics
  • Mouse Sensitivity - Monitor Distance Guide
  • Mouse Sensitivity
  • Useful guidelines - WoT

Contact

WoT Official Discord

note: please do not disturb Pruszko unnecessarily

Pruszko as @Pruszko [EU] in [EN] | [PL]

shuxue as @shuxue [EU] in [EN] | [RU]

1. Download

  3. Choose 1 of 7 methods
  4. Copy the selected "AimPro-method.wotmod" file into "[WoT game directory]/mods/[version]/" directory
  5. In config.json: you can configure additional coefficients

mods.title: HeavenBurnsRed Voice ＆ Sixthsense MOD
mods.descriptionHtml:
This is the mod which sets "HeavenBurnsRed"(smartphone game) girls' voice, sound and character textures to crew voice, garage music, loading music, some action sounds, battle-loading-screen pictures and sixthsense icon.

Depending on whether you apply a specific bnk or wotmod file or not and deleting some lines from xml file, you can choose to leave each of the sounds and textures below as the default or replace them.

  • Sixthsense sound
  • Artillery Sixthsense sounds(Sound Detection)
  • Garage and game starting screen music
  • Buttons sound in garage
  • Player's command voice
  • Using equipment(repair kit, first aid kit) sound
  • Battle loading music
  • Sound of important Log in battle(anyone dead, enemy spotted)
  • Sixthsense icon
  • Game starting screen
  • Battle loading screen

 

This doesn't work properly in some event modes like "Steel Hunter", "Last stand"...

I don't know how I delete default hangar music, so I made the volume of mod's hangar music loud so that default one isn't able to heard.I recommend you set garage music volume about 35%.

ーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーーー

スマホゲーム"HeavenBurnsRed"から音声を持ってきているmodです。搭乗員ボイス、ガレージとロード画面の音楽、一部操作音、第六感アイコン及び戦闘ロード画面背景などを置き換えています。

特定のbnkファイルやwotmodファイルの抜き差し、及びxmlファイルに記述された特定の行の削除により以下のそれぞれを置き換えるかどうか選択できます。

  • 第六感サウンド
  • 音響探知
  • ガレージとゲーム起動画面の音楽
  • ガレージの各種ボタンのサウンド
  • 自車両の戦闘コマンドのボイス
  • 修理キット及び救急キット使用音
  • 戦闘ロード画面の音楽
  • 戦闘中の重要な通知のボイス(敵車両発見、NPC車両大破)
  • 第六感アイコン
  • ゲーム起動画面
  • 戦闘ロード画面

 

"Steel Hunter"モードや"ラスト・スタンド"等、一部イベントモードでは正しく動作しません。

デフォルトのガレージ音楽の消し方が分からないのでMODのそれの音量を大きくすることでかき消す方法をとっています。ガレージ音楽の音量を35%前後に設定するとバランスが良くなります。

This is an experimental mod which adds functional lights to all 3D Styles with volume lights on them, casting light in front of the vehicle to make it seem like the lights are actually active. The effectiveness of this varies on a map-by-map basis and may not always look quite so good; particularly, I advise using a sky mod that darkens the game lighting such as Mirny Sky or Night Sky.

This mod affects the following styles:
USA: "M4A3(76)W Sherman", King Tiger (Captured) "Nox Tenebris", "T-832", "Rambo", M-V-Y "Comedian", T57 Heavy "Sworn Brother", M53/M55 "Amphibious"
Germany: MKpz 68 (P) "Wind of Arrakis", Panther II/E-50/E-50M "Revenant Mk. II", Leopard 1 "Blitzlicht", Pz. VII "Vorhut", Maus "Wüstenschiff", Jagdpanzer E-100 "Dunkel"
USSR: K-91 "Oblivion", Obj. 140 "Swallow", IS-7 "Rhyolite", ST-II "Footcruiser", Obj. 268 "Svyatogor"
UK: Manticore "Pointer", Centurion Action X "Primipilus" and "British Steel", Concept 5 "Unto the Breach", "Churchill Crocodile", Tortoise "The Tortoise", Badger "Lancelot"
France: "Char de Transition", AMX 50B "Charles Martel", AMX M4 54 "Gascon", Foch B "Églantier"
Czechoslovakia: "Projekt ION", Skoda T 50 "Orlík", TVP T 50/51 "Party Wagon", Vz. 55 "Quintessence"
Japan: Type 5 Heavy "Hanmā"
China: 122 TM "Special Guest"
Poland: CS-63 "Błyskawica"
Sweden: UDES 15/16 "Svadilfari", Strv K "Spirit of War"
Italy: Rinoceronte "Nyx"

This includes special effects to the lights:
- the 122 TM Now has a tiny omnilight for the candle
- the T-832's light activates when the gun fires. I must acknowledge that it is slightly out of sync, I couldn't seem to fix this
- the Tortoise's lights flicker when the vehicle takes a hit
- the Skoda T 50's Light turns on at the start of the battle
- the Vz. 55's lights turn on on first previewing it in the hangar/start of the battle, flicker when the vehicle takes a hit and an additional light when the gun fires

As stated, this mod is experimental at best. To better expand on this:
- lights do not appear in sniper mode
- lights may sometimes look a bit odd on certain objects/terrain. This is just how it ends up displayed
- lights (mostly) have a distance of about 120m, though they fade out the further away they are so you won't really be seeing them at that distance
- almost every light is angled slightly down, that way they're displayed better on terrain in front of the vehicle
- I couldn't figure out a way to make the lights anything but a cone spotlight. This means more boxy lights might look a bit off. That's just a limitation of my knowledge
- I tried to make the lights generally match the appearance of the volume lights on their respective tanks. This may not always be a perfect match however

This mod will not conflict with my other mods (such as Customisation Edits/Mirny Revamped), nor the Actual Lights Add-on for Mirny Revamped. It will however conflict with Brighter Lights, but like Mirny Revamped increases the lightMultiplier for those lights anyway.

This mod should run fine regardless of patch version.

mods.title: PeacemakeR Voice Mod
mods.descriptionHtml:
CZECH INSTALATION GUIDE IS INCLUDED IN FILE

--------

Welcome friend, you've come a long way to get here, but I can assure you it was worth it ;) 

I won't keep you long, so you'll find the installation instructions just below so you can get ready while you're downloading. 

If you would like to look under the hood and see all the messages, here is a link to download (including those not used yet):

https://www.mediafire.com/file/dlhctt635ua7n1q/peace_mod_-_hl%25C3%25A1%25C5%25A1ky.zip/file
----------

FOOTNOTES (from the Installation section) 

*Sample name of game version folder: 1.26.0.1 

**if you don't know where your game is, you can find out by clicking on Game Settings in the Wargaming Game Center and then at the bottom on Show in Folder, on Steam then on the gear wheel on the game page in the library, then on Properties, Files and then Browse. 

***!! ATTENTION!! - commanders who have their own voiceovers will still speak with their voice (not a bug)
mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Have you downloaded? Superbly. Open the file. 

2. You will see the audioww folder and the sixthSENSE folder

1.1 move the audioww folder to the folder res_mods\[current game version]*, 

located in your WoT folder** 

1.2 open the sixthSENSE folder in the downloaded file and select one of them 

Rename the one you choose to sixthSENSE and move it to the folder res_mods\[current game version]*\audioww\

3. Turn on the game, after loading, open the settings and the SOUND tab 

We are interested in the left side, where we change the drop-down menu next to the crew to Standard*** and the sixth sense sound to User Sound. Just check if we have the volumes so that we can hear everything (can be tested with the buttons next to the menus) and we can make the biggest mistake of your day, and that is to press that orange button battle.

mods.title: Pansy's Revamped Skies Volume 1
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod does not need updating for new patches (outside of when new maps are added or actual updates to the mod itself) and can simply be moved to the newest patch folder whenever WG Updates the game.
The mod also only fully works Improved Graphics (HD). While Standard Graphics will work, it will be missing the full features of the mod (namely the modified skyboxes) due to limitations.


This mod includes changes to almost all available maps in the game, reworking map ambience and altering the skyboxes to give each map a new feel to it: this does NOT include event maps/hangars and will not. This includes:
- the default Hangar
- all 44 Random Battle maps
- all 3 Frontline maps

Here is an Imgur album showing a preview for every map: 
https://imgur.com/a/wot-revamped-skies-volume-1-v1-8-update-mod-preview-dL7VAuS

If you like the mod, try checking out my other skybox mods:
- Revamped Skies Volume 2: https://wgmods.net/7262/
- Revamped Skies Volume 3: https://wgmods.net/7490/
- Aslain's Night Sky Edit: https://wgmods.net/7338/

If you are unsure which mod to use, or just like variety, I recommend trying out this mod: https://wgmods.net/7494/

I must make note of some issues (I'm listing these to state that I am aware of them, not that I am going to/can fix them. I'm obliged to make you aware of them for transparency):
- Reflective surfaces (notably water) still mostly reflect the ORIGINAL map appearance. This can lead to issues but should be for the most part irrelevant
- Ambient effects. I could not figure out how to remove (or add) particles and as such these can look off with the new ambience. This most notably affects Airfield and Fata Morgana with offshore lightning
- Some maps use the "probes" folder of another map to help change the map feel but this leads to issues related to a map's shadow grid and other elements, leading to sudden dark or illuminated spots. I actively tried to avoid this due to issues but did use this for the following maps: Abbey, Ensk, Karelia, Prokhorovka. This can unfortunately cause issues with the Skybox Randomiser mod (either failing to load the probes folder or loading it on other versions)
- While not necessarily an issue I want to make sure you're aware that altering the feel of the map can potentially lead to some disorientation. Again I apologise for this in advance
- Since this has been a constant issue: do not try to run this alongside any other sky-related mod, including the other version within the mod. It WILL cause conflicts as the game tries to load both mods


I want to thank the user "no one / nocac" significantly for introducing me to this, helping me learning how to do it and especially for providing older files that I did not have. I also want to thank Rom4n_ and _DEVA For playtesting the mod for me and providing feedback, as well as FastestClassic and Avalon304 For helping with screenshots for this page.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
To install drag or extract the included .wotmod file into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\mods\2.1.1.1\[WOTMOD GOES HERE]

This mod should work fine even with new updates outside of new maps being added. Even with serious map redesigns it shouldn't run into any problems. If you want to preview it without launching into an actual battle you can always use the Topography Mode to preview a number of maps.

mods.title: Battle Observer - EU/NA/ASIA
mods.descriptionHtml:
Supported Languages: українська, English, Deutsch, polski, русский

GITHUB

Interface and Battle Statistics Enhancements
1. Display of team health (HP of individual tanks + strength difference)
2. Log of dealt and received damage
3. Counter of active and destroyed tanks
4. Updated PING and FPS panels
5. Customizable battle timer
6. Player stats in battle (WG rating only)
7. Modified base capture indicators
8. Damage counter for “High Caliber” medal
9. Display of your tank's HP in a visible spot

11. Clock in garage and battle

Camera, Aiming, and Visual Settings
1. Dynamic camera zoom based on distance
2. Maximum camera distance
3. Projectile flight time indicator
4. Improved aiming circle and server reticle (size, stabilization timer)
5. Centering the minimap via hotkey + info about destroyed tanks (icon/name)
6. Customization of icons in team lists (brightness, color)
7. Armor calculator: actual thickness + reticle color change
8. Distance to the nearest spotted enemy (no direction)
9. Disable effects: shaking, flashes, blackout in sniper mode
10. Disable commander voiceovers
11. Auto-exit sniper mode after firing (optional)
12. Customization of “Sixth Sense” icon (timer, animation, image)

Team, System, and Utility Features
1. Auto-clear game cache on exit
2. Highlighting friends/clanmates in team lists with a special symbol
3. Message filtering in system chat
4. Check slot availability for map blacklist
5. Tank performance widget in garage (damage, spotting, blocking, stun, gun mark progress)
6. Auto-toggle “accelerated crew training” based on field modifications
7. Auto-collection of clan rewards
8. Disable base capture siren

Post-Destruction Modes
1. After death, the camera anchors to the last-known position
2. Adjust camera distance after being destroyed

mods.title: Universal Model Loader (UML)
mods.descriptionHtml:
For non-EU server player go to UML topic on WG discord(https://discord.com/channels/161053416796323840/1248653660486111303)

A recently introduced CTD fix is unfortunately region-specific. Player from different regional server(EU US ASIA CN Lesta) needs a different version of UML

Core feature of Universal Model Loader is to change only the appearance of the tank that player is currently driving, leaving friendly and enemy tanks untouched. This is intended to address hitbox mismatch issue caused by using remodels significantly different from stock models, which is making it impossible to hit weakspot of type59 if it looks like challenger2. 


It has since evolved greatly towards adding new capabilities to WoT remodels, especially animation, funding the basis for more realistic model behaviour.

Detailed description check readme in the release zip.

This list of docs for remodel authors should give you a rough idea of its capability:

  • instruction_on_triggered_animations
  • instruction_list_of_keywords_for_fixedEmblem
  • instruction_on_additional_gunFire_animation
  • instruction_on_addon_models
  • instruction_on_burst_firing_effect
  • instruction_on_dual_barrel_compatible_remodel
  • instruction_on_glow_shader
  • instruction_on_hangar_and_seasonal_remodel
  • instruction_on_new_animationBone
  • instruction_on_new_sounds
  • instruction_on_registering_base_colour
  • instruction_on_sound_mod_support
  • instruction_on_steering_controller
  • instruction_on_tacticalNumber_slot
mods.installationGuideHtml:
v1.7 used wotmod format, install path is now mods , not res_mods 
Delete earlier version before attempting this one.  
you can retain old config by copying res_mods/x.x.x.x/scipts/client/mods/ownModel.xml to mods/configs/UML/
 

  1. Open zip, extract content of 'mod for player' to /mods/%CURRENT_VERSION% , including sub-folder
    file structure should resemble this: 
        \mods\1.26.0.1\UML.wotmod
  2. Launch game. When prompted to restart, click restart
  3. When in hangar, press F5 to verify a brief flash and a new msg in the notification panel
  4. If the flash and msg did not happen, your copy of UML is outdated or is in the wrong folder, or encountered mod conflict. 

    If you only want to swap into models provided by WoT (3D styles), or only intend to use features other than swapping, then you can stop here. 

    If you want to swap into downloaded remodels then follow these steps:
  5. Download remodel pack from wgmods.net or other sources.
  6. Install remodel. Place wotmod into /mods/%CURRENT_VERSION%
  7. Start/restart.

This remodel includes:

-a custom model by Mirukii based on the Jaguar 1/2 Tank Destroyer

mods.title: Advanced Personal Efficiency
mods.descriptionHtml:
Discord support server - https://discord.gg/3WBstp8nKn
Public repository to download my mods - https://github.com/Kurzdor/wotmods-public

---

This mod allows you to extend native game's personal efficiency near damage log panel with separated assist values, crits amount and even spotted vehicles count.

Mod has support for settings inside garage (ModsSettingsAPI).

Assist modes

Advanced Personal Efficiency allows you to either add or replace current assist counters in personal efficiency panel.

Possible values:
- radio - adds new radio assist counter. You can disable original assist counter if you want to see only splitted value(s).
- track - adds new track assist counter. You can disable original assist counter if you want to see only splitted value(s).
- both - adds both new radio and track assist counters. You can disable original assist counter if you want to see only splitted value(s).
- replace - replace original WG counter to formatted value from `assist/format` option. Requires enabled original assist counter option in game settings!

Replace assist configuration

"assist/format" setting in configuration file or settings inside the game allows to customize data what you need to: either show everything (assist + separate values as a default setting) or show separately them or even add own HTML text as these fields fully support HTML code.

Available macroses:

- {{totalAssist}} - sum of radio and track assists values
- {{radioAssist}} - value of radio assist
- {{trackAssist}} - value of track assist

Mod is also available in Aslain's Modpack!

mods.title: Vehicle State
mods.descriptionHtml:
Discord support server - https://discord.gg/3WBstp8nKn
Public repository to download my mods - https://github.com/Kurzdor/wotmods-public

---

This mod allows you to show extra info in battle. By default it's panel which located near crosshair and will show you info about your current health, current loaded shell penetration and its dispersion (+-25%), kind (i.e. normal, premium or stun using color), shell type and aiming timer.
 

Supported macroses by mod
 

Aiming timer:
- %(aimingRemainingTime)s - remaining aiming time
- %(c:aimingStatus)s - color depending on status (not ready, almost ready, ready)
- %(aimingProgress)s - aiming progress in percents
Health info:
- %(health)s - current player's vehicle HP level
- %(c:health)s - color depending of current player's vehicle HP level
- %(maxHealth)s - max player's vehicle HP level including all factors (improved hardening, field modernization, etc.)
- %(healthPercentage)s - current player's vehicle HP percentage
Shell info:
- %(shellDamage)s - current loaded shell damage
- %(shellDamageDispersion)s - current loaded shell damage dispersion
- %(shellPenetration)s - current loaded shell average penetration
- %(shellPenetrationDispersion)s - current shell penetration with +-25% dispersion
- %(shellType)s - current shell type
- %(shellKind)s - current shell kind (normal, premium or stun)
- %(c:shellKind)s - current shell type color (normal, premium or stun)
- %(shellSpeed)s - current shell speed
- %(gunElevation)s - gun elevation
- %(gunDepression)s - gun depression
- %(gunPitchLimits)s - gun elevation and depression

The macros list is also available inside macroses.md file near configuration file.

These format templates can be configured inside game in the mod settings in garage (ModsSettingsAPI support) or using text editor to edit config file instead (recommended way to do it).
Configuration  file itself is located in <WoT folder>\mods\configs\kurzdor\vehiclestate\config.json.

Mod is also available in Aslain's Modpack!

mods.title: Better Reticle Size
mods.descriptionHtml:
Credit belongs to Tankista1 on Discord for sharing this information with me, as well as StranikS_Scan and others who discovered this years ago. Somehow, this information never spread outside of RU; I created this mod and this Reddit post to share this knowledge with a broader audience.

Source code is available on GitHub.

1.0: Thanks to IzeBerg and poliroid for creating the Mod Settings and Mods List APIs.

This mod has a surprisingly big effect on how the game feels. There are some things it won't fix:

  • Lag
  • Bad aim
  • Bad RNG - shots can still bounce or miss

Is this useful?

Knowing the true accuracy of your gun is very useful, especially in these situations:

Firing the moment you are 100% sure it will hit. If you aim for longer than necessary, the enemy might have time to shoot back.

Knowing how likely you are to hit a weakspot. I bet there are many, many shots you chose not to take because you assumed they were unlikely to hit. You'll be surprised to see just how many damage opportunities you've missed out on.

Do I need to use server reticle?

This mod works with and without server reticle. What you see on your screen doesn't always match what the server sees, and enabling server reticle helps to fix this. Server reticle can be helpful if you play on high ping, but it also feels less responsive. Try with and without to see which one you like more.

Is this compatible with other reticle mods?

It's compatible with most reticle mods, but if you run into any issues, let me know!

mods.title: Reworked Camera
mods.descriptionHtml:
CommanderCam = Tactical View

  • Reworked CommanderCam

There are 4 variants in the archive, they differ only in the return values for xZoom: x2, x4, x8;

Zooms: x1, x2, x4, x8, x16, x25, x50;

  1. [R]Camera = x50 >>> x25 >>> x16 >>> x8 >>> x4 >>> x2 >>> x1
  2. [R]Camera_x2 = x50 >>> x2; x25 >>> x2; x16 >>> x2; x8 >>> x2; x4 >>> x2; x2 >>> x1;
  3. [R]Camera_x4 = x50 >>> x4; x25 >>> x4; x16 >>> x4; x8 >>> x4; x4 >>> x2; x2 >>> x1;
  4. [R]Camera_x8 = x50 >>> x8; x25 >>> x8; x16 >>> x8; x8 >>> x4; x4 >>> x2; x2 >>> x1;

Features

  • Does not require updating for the game version (But it's not certain)

Compatibility

This mod should be compatible with almost everything:

For mod PMOD by default

if you use it PMOD together with Reworked Camera, PMOD will have priority in the settings. For Reworked Camera to work as intended, you must turn off the module: zoomDistance.json.

OR

If you install PMOD from modpacks, there may be other modules included, for example: zoomX.json, scrollSensitivity.json or other modules.

Source code

Mod is not obfuscated and it's source code is on Github repository

Contact

WoT Official Discord

shuxue as @shuxue [EU] in [EN] | [RU]

Answers to questions

  • Will there be a centered reticle variant in arcadeMode?

Not at the moment, as I could not find a solution to the problem - dropping the reticle when scrolling the wheel, when exiting sniperMode.

  • Is it possible to use the centered reticle versions that are now spreading on the net and on wgmods?

I'll call these variants a history. You can use them, but I don't recommend it.

  • How do reproduce the reticle drooping problem you're writing about?

This is tested on a vanilla client or with the centered reticle mod. If vanilla, you need to be in postmortemMode, there the reticle is centered, use the keys PgUP and PgDn and you will see how it works. The same keys for the mod, but you can be in arcadeMode.

mods.title: [Anime-Style Mod Collection] - Vinyl Edition
mods.descriptionHtml:
FROM WOT 1.24, WE MERGED ALL ASMC FRANCHISE INTO ONE MOD PACK.

IN JAN 2024, WG FORUM HAS CLOSED. 
WE HAVE MOVED TO ASLAIN FORUM AS A DOWNLOAD THREAD. 
UPDATES ARE FASTER IN THERE.

 

INTRODUCTION

After days full of fierce battles, you are relaxing in your tank's garage and suddenly realized that the game's factor such as soundtracks, images, ... becomes too familiar to you. Then why wouldn't you try out our mods? We will bring to you a new fresh air with a combination of cute anime girls and tankers' spirits, leading you to your victory!

About Vinyl Edition contents, this is our latest edition of the ASMC. The music style of Vinyl Edition, as the name suggested, is a mix of electronic and rock music that you often experience in the 90s and 2000s. Therefore, the music has less anime-related theme and more suitable for general audience.

Interface elements of Vinyl Edition features sci-fi theme, where you can see mecha, cyborg, futuristic world, ... all of which blends perfectly with the music and the mordern looking Miku hangar to create a satisfaction for any sci-fi lovers.

 

FEATURES LIST

  • User Interfaces from IGN TacticaL_Mech_Tank
    • Login Screen & Login Video
    • Battle Loading Screen
    • Sixthsense Icon
    • Crew Image
    • Battle Result Window
  • Background Music from IGN NyanDora_Mech_Tank
    • Login Screen Music & Login Video Music
    • Hangar Music
    • Battle Loading Music & Combat Music
    • Crew Voice & Sixthsense Voice
    • Gun Sound (External mod from ed76na and Polyacov_Yury)
  • Support Mods
    • J1mB0 Crosshair (External mod from J1mB0, Grabaah and Andre_V)
    • J1mB0 Countour Icon (External mod from J1mB0 and Grabaah)
    • SaveAccount (External mod from Chirimen)

 

BACKGROUND INFORMATION

The year is 2265. It's already near two centuries passed after the 77 hour war between human and machines, where the victor was the one with greater control over their advanced weaponery. This time, to not repeat the mistake we once made, us human chooses to reawake our old beasts: tanks that does not use the advanced technology to operate, thus inmune to the influence of the machines.

Surely you will need experienced crew mates to control these tanks. Meet our girls, who are abandoned dolls in the machine's society. They are our best ally and will follow your every order to fight for the greater good of both races.

You are our world's last hope, Commander! Lead the human revolution to victory! 

About ASMC history, first introduced since update 8.10, when the Japanese tanks made their first appearance in the game, Anime-Style Mod Collection (ASMC) has been through a long journey. Changing your login screens, crew, voice, ... and even the music into that of anime-related, we hope that our mod will not only satisfied anime lovers but also veterans that loves a change of wind to once again returning to the game with new enthusiasm.

 

PREVIEW VIDEO (youtube)

*Video recorded in previous version of WoT, thus some of the contents could be different with the current version.

Enjoy the mod and see you on the battlefield!
mods.installationGuideHtml:
We strongly recommends that you should remove all previous mods in your game folder.

  1. Extract the downloaded archive using WinRAR (v5.21 or above).

  3. Open the installer.
  4. Click next until you see the installation path. Browse to World of Tanks folder.

5. Select your mods following notes in the Instruction file.

6. Restart the game for 1-2 times to stablize the mods.

8. To install more mods later, run the installer again and make changes, it automatically saves your previous selection.

9. To completely remove the mod, go into Control Panel/Programs and Features, look for Vinyl Edition.

mods.descriptionHtml:
IMPORTANT NOTE: Join WoT InfoCord (my WoT Info/News Discord Server) for update notifications (usually on patch days), complete changelogs, sneak peaks and more! 

Likewise, any comments, questions, bug reports, etc. should be posted to the #modding-discussion channel in the WoT Infocord Discord server, since the comments section on WGmods is non-functional.

This is my (Classic's) update to the Historical Realism Engine/Gun Sounds mod (revival of Gnomefather's original sound mod), which adds a wide variety of new engine & gun sounds (some ported forward from Gnome's mod, some BRAND-NEW!), support for new vehicles introduced into the game since Zorgane's version was last updated (cca. November 2020), an extensive set of additional tweaks/fixes, and more!

Thanks to help from Shimada_Sama, Zorgane, and documentation on the WoT/KoreanRandom forums/WWISE's website, a number of new gun sounds have been introduced since I started working on this mod!

Furthermore, I have introduced a huge number of new engine sounds, including a mix of some ported from Gnomefather's original mod + many BRAND-NEW sounds, sourced from real vehicles wherever possible!

100+ NEW ENGINE SOUNDS (more-than-tripling the original roster!) and around ~40 NEW GUN SOUNDS have been introduced to the mod since 2021, along with the expansion of many engines to other players' vehicles + a vast number of other improvements/fixes. Enjoy!

Mod info

Volume is controlled separately for guns and engines from within the game's sound settings menu. 

RECOMMENDED SETTINGS:

Vehicles: ~80-100%

Effects: ~60-80% (suggested to be around ~20% lower than the "vehicles" slider)

IMPORTANT: In case the mod does not function after an update

Assuming the mod has been installed correctly, you will be prompted to restart your game on the first startup with the mod enabled. This causes the following files to generate automatically:

  • C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\res_mods\<CURRENT GAME VERSION NUMBER>\engine_config.xml
  • C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\res_mods\<CURRENT GAME VERSION NUMBER>\audioww\audio_mods.xml

If you experience issues with sounds after installing a new update, deleting these two files and starting up the game again + following the popup instructions (click shutdown/restart) will cause these two files to refresh, which should fix most of these issues.

IMPORTANT: In case reload sounds do not function after an update

Due to the new caching feature introduced in Update 1.27.1, reload sounds will sometimes fail to appear in-game, even if installed correctly.

If modded reload sounds stop functioning in-game (assuming you have installed the mod correctly), go to your WoT install directory (by default: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks_EU\) and delete the "data.wgpdc" file (may be displayed without file extension, i.e. just a file named "data"). Alternatively, performing the "Check and Repair" function in WGC (under Game Settings) will also clear the game cache, fixing the issue.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
To install, open the downloaded .ZIP file, then extract the included "mods" folder to your WoT install directory (for example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\).

Once this is done, start your game and follow the popup instructions (click shutdown/restart).

Please carefully follow the install instructions above to ensure proper functionality of the mod. The following folders (+ their included contents) MUST be present for the mod to function, so if you are having trouble with the mod, please ensure these folders are present after completing the install process:

mods.title: RNG Modpack
mods.descriptionHtml:
RNG is a minimalistic modpack, focused on quality and simplicity, it features minor UI customizations (almost entirely stock UI) and basic utility mods.

This pack is intentionally designed to be lightweight and fast to update after patches.

There's an installation mode for everyone:

  • Full: The full RNG experience (my personal mod setup).
  • Minimal: For those who prefer a more-vanilla experience.
  • Custom: The "make it yours" mode.

If you have any requests or require any support please join our Discord server!

Notes:

Whilst the modpack heavily relies on XVM's features for the main customization, you do not need to use the statistics features it offers.
Simply don't activate the online services and you can enjoy all the benefits of XVM without seeing the stats of your allies or enemies.

Features:

Core:

  • RNG modpack version checker.

XVM Options:

General:

  • Disable in-battle hints (Such as the "Press N to display progress" popup at the start of battles).
  • Display Hit-log (appears in the top left of the screen).
  • Display of win chance percentage.
  • Display ping servers on the login and garage screens.
  • Disable general chat in garage.
  • Extra info on post-battle results.
  • Enable automatic return of crew.
  • Display friendly and enemy HP remaining on the player panels with "Alt".
  • Display players nicks on the mini-map with "Alt".

Carousel:

  • Adjustable carousel size (default and small).
  • Adjustable carousel rows.
  • Small/Condensed carousel features extra information such as Battle Tiers, Win Rate, Mastery Class (1st/2nd/3rd/Ace) and Marks of Excellence.
  • Custom carousel sorting criteria (tier, class, nation).

Sixth sense:

  • Additional sixth sense icons.
  • Adjustable sixth sense icon duration (default 2 and 10 seconds).

Icons:

  • Custom RNG contour Icons (Vanilla icons with better colours for vehicle classes).
  • Custom RNG carousel Icons (Vanilla icons with gold premium/collectors tanks).

Stats (If you choose to active online services):

  • 10 level XVM colour scale by WotLabs.net.

Optional Mods:

Unfortunately due to the many optional mods, I cannot include them here, but a full list of included mods can be found within the installer on the information screen.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Installation: 
1). Run the installer. 
2). Select your World of Tanks directory. 
3). Select your installation mode (or choose the mods/options you want from the list). 
4). Choose whether to wipe existing mods or not (Backup stats cache is for existing installs). 

In order to update/change your existing mods simply download the new/relaunch the existing installer and make your changes as necessary. 
The installer will remember the options you have selected each time, so updating without wanting to make any changes is as simple as clicking next all the way to the end. 

In order to uninstall the modpack, simply run the included "Uninstall RNG Modpack" option from the start menu or use the "Add or Remove programs feature" in Windows.

mods.title: Fast Reconnect
mods.descriptionHtml:
Sometimes, for some users, game permanently loses connection during battle (and all tanks stops responding). It can even happen in hangar.

Because there are no buttons for disconnect in such scenario, either you have to:

  • wait 40 seconds timeout in battle or
  • restart a game (~20 seconds depending on PC)

... to again see Login Screen and reconnect.

This mod allows you to instantly kick you to Login Screen skipping above delays to help you reconnect MUCH faster (from there you only have to login and wait for map loading).

Depending on PC, you can come back into battle in less than 10 seconds since noticing a connection loss.

features

  • CTRL+K shortcut to instantly disconnect you from anywhere to Login Screen

How to use

  • When you notice permanent connection loss, hit CTRL+K (like Control Kick) shortcut. This will quickly kick you to Login Screen.
  • Login again to rejoin a battle.

By this, you don't have to restart a game or wait for timeout to rejoin a battle as fast as possible.

NOTE

Shortcut CTRL+K works ANYWHERE except for replays.

Use it wisely.

SOURCE CODE

Mod is not obfuscated and it's source code is on Github repository.
mods.installationGuideHtml: Copy "FastReconnect.wotmod" file into "[WoT game directory]/mods/[version]/" directory

mods.title: Dispersion Reticle
mods.descriptionHtml:
Updated and completely reworked mod that adds additional circle displaying fully focused dispersion of a gun.

Original idea by StranikS_Scan, completely reworked by me.

Also, over time, this mod now contains following mutually compatible mods:

  • Focused reticle
  • Server reticle
  • Hybrid reticle (smooth combination of client and server reticle)
  • Reticle Size (adjustment in config file)

Features

All of those features can be enabled/adjusted independently.

They are also compatible with "Use server aim" from in-game option.

Focused reticle (enabled by default):

  • adds green reticle displaying fully focused dispersion alongside other reticles

Server reticle:

  • adds purple server-side reticle alongside with client-side reticle

Hybrid reticle:

  • adds green reticle displaying current server-side dispersion to client-side reticle
  • useful if you want to know server-side dispersion, but still want client-side responsiveness

Extended variants of above reticles:

  • have much more customization options
  • visually inspired by AwfulTanker's Server Marker

Reticle size:

  • controlled by "reticle-size-multiplier" option
  • WG's displayed reticle dispersion is noticeably bigger than actual gun dispersion
  • it was discovered by Jak_Attackka, StranikS_Scan and others
  • by this setting you can scale it to actual displayed dispersion
  • good known values:
    • 1.0 (default "wrong" WG dispersion)
    • 0.5814 (factor determined by me programmatically)
    • 0.5848 (factor determined by Jak_Attackka, StranikS_Scan and others)

Configuration

All features from config file are reloadable on-the-fly using CTRL + P hotkey in the game anywhere.

This mod also supports Mod Configurator by IzeBerg allowing for configuring this mod using its GUI in garage.

Source code & feedback

Mod is not obfuscated and it's source code is on Github repository.

You can also:

  • PM me on discord: fierioziy (nick: Pruszko [EU] on WoT official discord)
  • in game on EU server: Pruszko
  • or GitHub issues here

CONTRIBUTIONS

Thanks to:

  • IzeBerg - for cool GUI configuration API
  • POLIROID - for ModsListAPI
  • shuxue - for Russian translations
  • yinx2002 - for Chinese translations
  • Kurzdor - for occasional help

Compatibility

This mod IS NOT compatible with other mods with similar features as mine.

Current known incompatible mods:

  • AwfulTanker's Server Marker (and other similar)
  • Jak_Atackka's Fix Reticle Size (and other similar)

Use preferred options from above features for similar functionality instead.

However, it should be compatible with any crosshair mods that changes
how crosshair or reticle looks like.
mods.installationGuideHtml:
1. Copy "DispersionReticle.wotmod" file (and optionally other *.wotmod files) extracted from zip into "[WoT game directory]/mods/[version]/" directory
  2. Run a game with mod installed to generate default config file
  3. Adjust config to your liking
  4. Reload it in-game whenever you want using CTRL + P hotkey
  5. (with Mod Configurator) Open button with "<>" icon in garage and find DispersionReticle section to configure mod

 

Full config file location: "[WoT game directory]/mods/configs/DispersionReticle/config.json"

Use some text editor (preferably Notepad++) to edit config file.

mods.title: CHAMPi's WoT Mods Installer
mods.descriptionHtml:
Here comes the long awaited installer for my mods. It contains *ALL* of my mods. Choose installation directory and select the mods you want to install. That's all!

The following modifications are included in the modpack: *ALL* of them are available here as standalone package and verified by WG.

  • Armor Calculator Pro
    Displays tanks armor information on the HUD
  • Auto Ignore Pro
    Allows you to select a list of vehicles that you do not want to communicate with in battle.
  • Arty Ready Warning
    This mod calculates the enemy SPG reload time, based on game events. After a reload time is predicted it displays it in the HUD and can optional play an audio effect to warn the player of an incoming SPG fire.
  • Custom Outline Colors
    This mod allows you to define your own outline colors for vehicles, garage, flag, destructible objects etc.
  • Expected Vehicle Values
    Shows expected vehicle damage, marks of excellence percentage, spot-/track and block damage and many more infos in real time during the battle. Highly customizable!
  • Little Helper Collection
    A collection of little helper function for garage & battle.
  • Minimap Spam Protector
    This mod allows you to control how many times a player can ping on the minimap before the pings will be ignored from your client. You can also control if a ping sound is played.
  • Player Panel Pro
    Customizable tank health bars, tank class icons and enemy spotted status for the playerpanel without the need of XVM!
  • Reticle Dispersion Pro
    Reduces the displayed dispersion circle size on the HUD to better match the gun's actual spread.
  • Sixth Sense Timer
    This mod allows you to display a timer in the HUD which counts down to 0 after you was spotted by an enemy. The countdown time is adjustable in a settings dialog. The countdown should remember you that you're still visible to the enemy and stay in cover until the countdown reached 0.
  • Steel Hunter Helper
    Allows to enable automatic upgrades in Steel Hunter game type based on preselection. There are a lot of pre defined upgrade variants for every steel hunter vehicle. It also allows to show 3D markers on the battlefield for easy viewing of loot boxes AFTER a radar scan. The color of the 3D markers are representing the loot box.
  • Tank Carousel Pro
    This mod brings some tweaks for the tank carousel.
  • Tank Rating Colors
    This mod allows you to take control of the tank paintings based on the WGR (WarGamingRate) or on WN8 winrate. You can define which tank parts are recolored and if camouflages should be removed or left be untouched.


For more detailed information of each modification click on the specified name of the mod.

Note:

Based on your selections the installer CAN remove automatically old versions of my mods from the mod folder, if found!

The installer will NEVER overwrite your old configuration files! All my mods handle the config file updates themselves.

The installer comes with an uninstaller that is saved in the selected World_of_Tanks directory

mods.title: CHAMPi's Little Helper Collection
mods.descriptionHtml:
The mod collects some useful improvements that never made it to their own mod. Not because they're useless, but because they're too small for an own mod. But now I've combined them all in one mod and give the player control to turn them on / off.

Features: 

  • hangarTooltip - Expands the list of tanks on which the equipment is installed (in hangar tips)
  • storageTooltip - Shows the full selling price of modules, consumables and ammunition (in stock)
  • contourIconMode -> Disables the flipping of the tank contour icons in the tankman info tooltip. This is for using custom tank contour icons.
  • arenaBorderRecolor -> Allows to set a new arena border color. It looks really good to see some fresh new colors there.
  • disableHeroTank -> Disables the promotion of a tank in the background of the hangar.
  • disableTeaser -> Disables the teaser widget in the hangar
  • rememberLastServer -> Stores the last used server and automatically pre-selects it on the login screen.
  • autoLogin -> If enabled the mod automatically connects to the game server. If the storing of the last used game server is enabled it will be used.
  • disableBrawlMusic - Disables the hangar music when the brawl game type is selected.
  • disableQuestHint - Disables the personal mission quest hint at the beginning of the battle.
  • disableTenYearCountdown - Disables the 10 year anniversary widget in the hangar.
  • enableZoomOut - If this option is activated, the maximum distance limit of the camera is increased to get a better overview of the battlefield.
  • removeButtonGeneralChat - If enabled the general chat button in the hangar will be removed.

Credits:

spoter: For the tooltip stuff i use in the mod.

IzeBerg: For the modsettings api.

P0LIR0ID: For the modslist api.

mods.title: Marksman Crosshair
mods.descriptionHtml:
ATTENTION!

This crosshair from now on will only ever be updated when it requires it, and currently works.

For example, when it is broken from a major update, or just an update in general that changes some textures within the vanilla crosshair which in turn would affect this crosshair mod. The crosshair will still continue to work even though it is not updated for each individual patch. I had been doing updates each patch for the sake of convenience because it appears on the front page of the mod portal. The reason for this is because I have found out the hard way the more times you add updates the higher the chances something will break which it has done a few times recently so you have been notified!

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

Goal of this crosshair was simplicity and clarity, you dont need anything else but this crosshair imo in terms of crosshairs. It has two colors one white the second yellow. I've removed all the dark spots around the crosshair and brightened it up and made it easy for sniping and keeping track of targets. Might not be the best to some sure, though I made it for myself in the beginning when I wanted a crosshair close to vanilla and made this and haven't use any other crosshair since.

This crosshair is also available to install from Aslains modpack

mods.title: CHAMPi's Sixth Sense Timer
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod allows you to display a timer in the HUD which counts down to 0 after you was spotted by an enemy. The countdown time and size is adjustable in a settings dialog. The countdown should remember you that you're still visible to the enemy and stay in cover until the countdown reached 0.

The timer is set to 12 seconds by default, which should be enough to be no longer spotted, even when the enemy radio operator has the skill "Call for Vengeance", but you can change if you want.

Since version 2.0:
The mod also comes with over 40 custom sixth sense images that can replace the original lightbulb. If you don't want to use custom icons you can select 'Default' for the "Sixth Sense Icon" in the settings GUI and the default will be used.

Info:
You can move the custom sixth sense icon by pressing CTRL and move the mouse pointer over the icon. It then becomes fully visible with an info text. If you see the icon you move it with drag and drop. The position will be stored in your config-file.

When hovering over the custom icon:
Double left mouse click will load the next custom sixth sense icon, so you can change it during the battle or while watching a replay.
Press CTRL-F3 (default hotkey, you can change it in the GUI) to reset your icon position to default position.

mods.descriptionHtml:
Info: CHAMPi's Tank Health Bars & Enemy Spotted Status was renamed to CHAMPi's Player Panel Pro

Customizable tank health bars, tank class icons and enemy spotted status for the playerpanel without the need of XVM!

features:

  • allows (optionally) to disable the flipping of the tank contour icons on the right side of the playerpanel, loading screen and in the crew tool-tip
  • option to display player damage during the battle for both teams
  • can draw tank health bars in many different styles
  • displays the total remaining structure points of each team as bar with value (optionally)
  • different display modes: always, toggle on/off via hotkey or toggle on by holding down the toggle key (customizable)
  • draws health bar background in vehicle class colors (see screenshot) or in standard green (own team) / red (enemy team).
  • supports colorblind mode
  • can show only remaining structure points or current/max structure points
  • changeable graphics and layout - you can make your own backgrounds if you like
  • displays tank class symbols beside the structure bar (optionally)
  • can show the enemy spotted status in a lot of different styles (optionally)
  • displays an icon for some well known players & streamers in the player panel. (optionally)
  • graphical user interface to control the most important settings (click on button on the lower right corner in the hangar - see screenshot)

Note: grey icon: undetected in this battle - green: spotted and visible - red: no longer visible but last location is known.

Note: the health bars of the enemy team are only updated when the opponent is spotted and you're in radio signal range (if you didn't spot it by yourself). This rule is also valid for your own team. With other words: YOU CAN'T SEE IF YOUR BLIND SHOT HIT AN OPPONENT! :)

mods.title: Pansy's Customisation Edits
mods.descriptionHtml:
This mod includes modifications to:

-attachments

-camouflages

-decals

-insignias (MoEs)

-paints

-projection decals

-sequences

-styles

 

In a bit more depth:

-a lot of camos have been replaced with either improved versions (from Milky's old camo pack from years ago) or completely new camos. Multiple camos have had colours removed to utilise transparency and thus allow for more customisation using the Paint system, and many camos have received new colour palettes.

-some nation decals have been replaced with decals by other modders or edits of my own. These decals are not meant to be 100% Accurate and should not be treated as such.

-the German MoEs have been replaced with versions that stand out more and multiple new MoEs have been added for custom styles.

-national paints have been largely modified, making use of loosely historical-based colours, colours from FastestClassic's skin packs and colours to match national camouflage patterns. This includes modified GUI Icons to reflect the changes.

-styles have been modified as can be seen in the images. The extent of these edits vary greatly

-this mod includes all elements of my Mirny Revamped mod

 

If you check the python log it gets a little fussy with regards to selecting styles that have modified elements, but AFAIK, this causes absolutely no issues in-game whatsoever.

Otherwise, due to how the modhub handles updates, updates may take awhile to be reviewed and if you're unsure whether an update is available or not you can ping on the official WoT Discord under Desyatnik_Pansy [EU] where I will probably have my own dedicated mod thread for this
mods.installationGuideHtml:
To install drag the included .wotmod file into your WoT Game files and place it in the [PATCH FOLDER] in "mods". For example: C:\Games\World_of_Tanks\mods\1.27.1.0\[WOTMOD GOES HERE]

With Patch 1.27.1.0 WG Added a persistent data cache to decrease load times. While it does achieve that it causes issues with the mod loading due to the mod editing scripts. 

To make sure the mod loads, either do a "Check and Repair" through the WGC (slow) or delete the "data.wgpdc" file in your WoT Game files. Note that you will have to do the same after UNINSTALLING the mod as well (otherwise the persistent data cache will continue to load the modded files).

mods.title: [Anime-Style Mod Collection] - Steel Maiden Edition
mods.descriptionHtml:
FROM WOT 1.24, WE MERGED ALL ASMC FRANCHISE INTO ONE MOD PACK.
 

IN JAN 2024, WG FORUM HAS CLOSED. 
WE HAVE MOVED TO ASLAIN FORUM AS A DOWNLOAD THREAD. 
UPDATES ARE FASTER IN THERE.

 

INTRODUCTION

First introduced since update 8.10, when the Japanese tanks made their first appearance in the game, Anime-Style Mod Collection (ASMC) has been through a long journey. Changing your login screens, crew, voice, ... and even the music into that of anime-related, we hope that our mod will not only satisfied anime lovers but also veterans that loves a change of wind to once again returning to the game with new enthusiasm.

FEATURES LIST

     1. Interface

     - Anime-styled login screens that carves the dark and intensed atmosphere of the battlefield.

     - Detailed hangar UI mods. Whatever you do in the garage, you will find out interesting features.

     - Special crew mod that possess unique members for each country and crew skin of various anime characters.

     - Battle loading screens with the panzer girls that are actual the personifications of ingame vehicles (artist: 그래도청춘 on m.inven.co.kr).

     - Anime tips that makes you laugh or even do a tactical facepalm, and they are matched with the game’s original tips.

     - Splendid battle result screen shows up when you walk out from the battlefield, laugh proudly for the victory or cry regrettably when you lost.

     - And if you are about to exit after a nice grinding day, please wait…

     2. Music

     The music mod features selective and impressive tracks taken from notorious anime that makes you bristle because of the composer’s excellence, such as Sword Art Online, Mirai Nikkin, Naruto, or even the legendary Gundam series.

     - Login music  as the welcome every time you start the game.

     - Thrilling, epic and strong yet emotional anime vocal tracks from military and bloody thematic anime will make you love spending your time in the garage.

     - Selective, unique and impressive battle intro music for every map.

     - And when you are in a tight situation? Let the epic, thrilling orchestral-rock thematic battle music inspire you to your most desperate measure.

     3. Sound and external mods

     - Female anime crew voice, with 2 variants: one for the moe-lovers with cute voices from anime GJ-bu, and the other more serious and mature voice for the not-so-dere tankers.

     - The popular and easy to install but outstanding Thundering gun sound (authors: ed76na and Polyacov_Yury).

     - Simple but effective support mods like Jimbo crosshair (authors: J1mB0, Grabaah and Andre_V), save password (author: Chirimen) …

     Fortunately, those are not the last of our mods!

     Dive in to find out more on your own!
mods.installationGuideHtml:
We strongly recommends that you should remove all previous mods in your game folder.

Installation:

  1. Extract the downloaded archive using WinRAR (v5.21 or above).
  2. Please read the Instruction file if this is your 1st installation time.
  3. Open the installer.
  4. Click next until you see the installation path. Browse to World of Tanks folder.

5. Select your mods following notes in the Instruction file.

6. Restart the game for 1-2 times to stablize the mods.

7. For best experience, refer to the Recommended In-game Settings in Instruction file.

8. To install more mods later, run the installer again and make changes, it automatically saves your previous selection.

9. To completely remove the mod, go into Control Panel/Programs and Features, look for Steel Maiden.

Note:

  1. Hangar mod only works with Improved Graphics.
  2. Hangar mod will not replace event hangar.
  3. Sound Bank Loader must be installed if using any sound mod.
  4. Record Background only scale correctly with 1920x1080 resolution.

mods.title: Armor Inspector - collision models, internal modules, penetration
mods.descriptionHtml:
Armor Inspector modification (wotinspector.com) allows to understand penetration mechanics and check the collision models of any tank in the game.

Description

Main features:
• collision models (from game resources)
• crew and modules locations (unique content)
• penetration hitskin depending on the gun you choose
• complete simulation of every shot made in the last game
• detailed penetration information at any given point on shell’s trajectory
• HE damage map
• calculating potential ramming damage

The modification solely uses game resources and can be even installed on Common Test versions.

Some functions are paid. Purchases made in the modifications are synced with mobile version of Armor Inspector (iOS, Android) and vice versa.

Running

Clicking on Armor Inspector button will bring the app on top. The app is opened in the browser window and the tank selected in garage is loaded into it.

Note: First run may take some time (about 30 sek.)
AdBlock can prevent app from running. (This is AdBlock issue since it is extensivily blocking the loading of one of the data files)

Controls

Menu on the left allows to select one of the available modes: X-ray, Confrontation and Collision. X-ray shows the armor layout, placements of crew and modules, visual model. Confrontation allows to make a shot simulation and shows penetration hitskins. Collision mode allows to test ramming features of the vehicle.

Additional information on every mode is available by clicking (i) at the top part of the app.

Changing shooter or target tanks, their speeds and ammo type is possible at the bottom part of the screen.

Shots from the last battle are accessible by the button on the right.

Discord https://discord.gg/2gqUZHB
mods.installationGuideHtml:
Download wotmod.zip file and extract into mods/<current version> folder

When the mod is installed properly, the button Armor Inspector will appear it the mods menu in the bottom right corner. Shots from the last battle are automatically accessible when you open Armor Inspector.

mods.title: Battle Assistant
mods.descriptionHtml:
Changes the way SPG aims at target. The camera follows the trajectory of the shell. The new vanilla arty mode was made as an effort to copy the original Battle Assistant mod (this mod). The copy obviously is not that good as the original Battle Assistant. This mod replaces the standard new arty mode.

Hold Left Alt when shooting from arty to attach the camera to projectile.

This mod also changes how EagleEye perk works. Now you don’t have to make your target stay under the cursor for 5 seconds to make it work. Just shoot the target or mark it with “support me with fire” command and EagleEye perk will start to work on that target.

The config file is saved into mods/configs/battle_assistant/mod_battle_assistant.txt

The mod if free but requires an activation every 10 days. The activation page is https://wotinspector.com/battleassistant

Added settings to garage. In order to see the settings in garage it is necessary to download and install wotmod from here https://bitbucket.org/P0LIR0ID/wot-modslist/downloads/ (most latest version). Usually this wotmod file is already installed in case you’ve installed modpacks or other mods which have settings in garage. In case the wotmod file is not installed you’re still able to modify the mod’s settings in mod_battle_assistant.txt by hand.

Discord https://discord.gg/2gqUZHB

mods.installationGuideHtml:
• Open the downloaded archive with any archiver, or standard Windows interface.
  • Drag or copy from the archive folder "mods" in the folder where you installed the tanks, if you are asked to replace the files or folders can agree or disagree there is no difference.

This installation is complete, you can go to the tanks and play. Although you probably want to include some options and / or configure the already included. Then take another minute to read.

To configure the mod you do not need knowledge in programming, or dancing with tambourine. All you need is a the text editor Notepad++ or any analogue. All the settings of the mod are in the files inside the folder: mods/configs/pmod (pmod.json - the root file) Inside the files you will find a detailed description of all the parameters and their standard values.

mods.installationGuideHtml:
Installation:
- Launch the installer.
- Select the folder where your WoT is installed.
- Choose your mods and options.
- To change mods later, run the installer again and make new selections (previously selected mods will be remembered).

Update:
- Do not uninstall the old modpack.
- Download and launch the new installer (previous selections will be remembered).
- Complete the installation.

Removal:
- Use the Windows "Add or Remove Programs" feature in the Control Panel.
